titleZh: 千手千眼观世音菩萨广大圆满无碍大悲心陀罗尼（大悲咒全本）
titleEnglish: Great Compassion Dhāraṇī of Ārya Avalokiteśvara (Nīlakaṇṭha)
translatorZh: 唐·西天竺沙门伽梵达磨 译 / 唐·不空三藏 译对音本
sutraSourceZh: 《千手千眼观世音菩萨广大圆满无碍大悲心陀罗尼经》(T20n1060) 暨《大悲心陀罗尼修行念诵略仪》(T20n1113B)
deityZh: 千手千眼圣观自在菩萨 (Sahasrabhuja-sahasranetra Āryāvalokiteśvara / Nīlakaṇṭha)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 汉传与唐密最为核心的根本大咒（通行本共84句）。本词条直接接入下载自 CBETA 官方库之《T20n1113B》334个悉昙梵字与汉字逐字对音数据，以及《T20n1064》唐代不空三藏译本之八十四句本尊化身夹注，全咒由初段归敬文、观音胜号、根本心咒、大自在天/那罗延天化身赞及吉祥祈愿结文组成。
recitationTipsZh: 持诵时注意 r 音（如 ratna, trayāya, kāruṇikāya）需舌尖轻弹上颚（唐代注「转舌呼」）；长元音 ā, ī, ū, e, o 均属重音（Guru，2拍），短元音 a, i, u 属轻音（Laghu，1拍），轻重分明则梵音自然庄严流畅。

provenance.editionCitation: CBETA XML-P5 T20n1060 (伽梵达磨译) / T20n1064 & T20n1113B (唐·不空三藏译，含 334 个 #SD-* 悉昙梵字逐字对音与八十四句本尊夹注)；梵文重构参校 Sylvain Lévi & Lokesh Chandra 校勘梵本。
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 已从 github.com/cbeta-org/xml-p5 下载 T20n1060.xml、T20n1064.xml 与 T20n1113B.xml 原典并提取 334 个悉昙-汉文对音字元。

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya | namo āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākāruṇikāya |
verses.meaningZh: 归命三宝！归命圣观自在菩萨摩诃萨（大勇猛有情）、具大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels! Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, the Bodhisattva, the Great Being, the Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 南无喝啰怛那哆啰夜耶（一）南无阿唎耶（二）婆卢羯帝烁钵啰耶（三）菩提萨跢婆耶（四）摩诃萨跢婆耶（五）摩诃迦卢昵迦耶（六）
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 拿摩 啦特拿-特啦呀呀 | 拿摩 阿哩呀-瓦洛给帝-湿瓦啦呀 博地-萨特瓦呀 玛哈-萨特瓦呀 玛哈-嘎鲁尼嘎呀
verses.tangNoteZh: 唐·不空《T20n1064》夹注：第一至六句为慈悲观音及如意轮、转钵、不空羂索、马鸣菩萨本身，统摄三宝与观音本尊总归敬门。

words.transliterationZh: 阿唎耶婆卢羯帝烁钵啰耶

verses.iast: oṃ sarvarabhaye sudhanadasya namaskṛtvā imam āryāvalokiteśvaravaṃdavaṃ nīlakaṇṭha nāma hṛdayaṃ |
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！于一切畏惧中善施安稳者！顶礼彼圣观自在尊已，我今宣说此名为「青颈（Nīlakaṇṭha）」之广大圆满心咒：
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Having bowed to Him who bestows safety amidst all fears, I now proclaim this glorious heart-dhāraṇī of Noble Avalokiteśvara called Nīlakaṇṭha (Blue-Necked One):
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵（七）萨皤啰罚曳（八）数怛那怛写（九）南无悉吉㗚埵伊蒙阿唎耶（十）婆卢吉帝室佛啰楞驮婆（十一）南无那啰谨墀（十二）醯利摩诃皤哆沙咩（十三）
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 嗡 萨尔瓦-啦巴耶 苏达拿达斯呀 拿玛斯克哩特瓦 伊芒 阿哩呀-瓦洛给帝-湿瓦啦万达旺 尼啦干他 拿玛 赫哩达央
verses.tangNoteZh: 唐·不空夹注：「唵」是诸神合掌听诵，「萨皤啰罚曳」是四天大王降魔，「那啰谨墀」是青颈观音贤爱慈悲心体。

words.meaningZh: 于一切怖畏灾难中 / 一切自在尊
words.meaningEn: in all fears / to all lords

words.meaningZh: 善施妙财法宝者之（教敕）
words.meaningEn: of the bestower of good wealth/grace

words.meaningZh: 青颈尊（代众生吞咽苦毒现青颈相）
心中心、真实心陀罗尼（我将宣说 avartayiṣyāmi）

verses.iast: sarvārthasādhanaṃ śubham ajeyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhavamārgaviśodhakaṃ | tadyathā | oṃ ālokaprabhā lokātikrānta |
verses.meaningZh: 能成就一切义利、纯善吉祥、无能胜伏，能彻底清净一切众生之生死轮回道！即说咒曰：嗡！光明遍照尊、超越世间者！
verses.meaningEn: Accomplishing all aims, auspicious, invincible, purifying the path of existence for all beings! Namely: Oṃ! Effulgent Light, Transcender of the World!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 萨婆阿他豆输朋（十四）阿逝孕（十五）萨婆萨哆那摩婆萨哆那摩婆伽（十六）摩罚特豆（十七）怛侄他（十八）唵阿婆卢醯（十九）卢迦帝（二十）迦罗帝（二十一）
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 萨尔瓦尔他萨达南 舒邦 阿杰央 萨尔瓦-布达南 巴瓦玛尔嘎维硕达刚 | 达地呀他 | 嗡 阿洛嘎普啦巴 洛嘎-帝克兰达
verses.tangNoteZh: 唐·不空夹注：第十八句「怛侄他」为正入心咒，「阿婆卢醯卢迦帝」为大梵天王与帝释诸天侍从观音放光济世。

words.meaningZh: 清净三有生死轮回之道
words.meaningEn: purifier of the path of samsaric existence

verses.iast: ehi hare mahābodhisattva sarpa sarpa smara smara mama hṛdayaṃ | kuru kuru karma | dhuru dhuru vijayate mahāvijayate |
verses.meaningZh: 善来，狮子王大菩萨！速疾降临、忆念我之本心！成就一切圣业！任持、任持最胜尊、大最胜尊！
verses.meaningEn: Come, O Lion (Hari), Great Bodhisattva! Glide forth, remember my heart-essence! Perform the sacred action! Uphold the Victorious One, the Greatly Victorious One!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 夷醯唎（二十二）摩诃菩提萨埵（二十三）萨婆萨婆（二十四）摩啰摩啰（二十五）摩醯摩醯唎驮孕（二十六）俱卢俱卢羯蒙（二十七）度卢度卢罚阇耶帝（二十八）摩诃罚阇耶帝（二十九）
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 诶嘿 哈咧 玛哈-博地-萨特瓦 萨尔巴 萨尔巴 斯玛啦 斯玛啦 玛玛 赫哩达央 | 古鲁 古鲁 嘎尔玛 | 杜鲁 杜鲁 维佳呀帝 玛哈-维佳呀帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 唐·不空夹注：第二十二句「夷醯唎」为三十三天魔醯首罗天主领天兵护持，「俱卢俱卢羯蒙」为空身菩萨，「度卢度卢」为严峻菩萨。

words.meaningZh: 狮子王尊、金色尊（观音异名）

words.transliterationZh: 罚阇耶帝摩诃罚阇耶帝
words.meaningEn: O Victorious and Greatly Victorious One

verses.iast: dhara dhara dharaṇīrāja | cala cala mama vimalamūrte re | ehy ehi kṛṣṇasarpavīta-yajñopavīta | viṣa viṣaṃ praṇāśaya |
verses.meaningZh: 受持、受持，总持自在王！行动、行动，令我显发无垢清净法身！善来善来，以黑蛇缠身作梵线者，请彻底摧灭一切贪瞋痴毒害！
verses.meaningEn: Hold fast, O Sovereign of Dhāraṇīs! Move forth, O Spotless Form of mine! Come, come, O One wearing the black serpent as sacred thread, destroy all poison!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 陀啰陀啰（三十）地唎尼（三十一）室佛啰耶（三十二）遮啰遮啰（三十三）摩摩罚摩啰（三十四）穆帝隶（三十五）伊醯伊醯（三十六）室那室那（三十七）阿啰嘇佛啰舍利（三十八）罚沙罚嘇（三十九）佛啰舍耶（四十）
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 达啦 达啦 达啦尼啦佳 | 佳啦 佳啦 玛玛 维玛啦穆尔帝 咧 | 诶嘿 诶嘿 克哩什拿萨尔巴维达-呀吉尼优巴维达 | 维沙 维伤 普啦拿沙呀
verses.tangNoteZh: 唐·不空夹注：第三十至四十句为观音大丈夫身、狮子王兵、霹雳菩萨、摧碎菩萨把金轮降伏三毒魔障。

words.meaningZh: 大地自在王 / 总持之王
words.meaningEn: O King of the Earth / Lord of Dhāraṇīs

words.meaningZh: 彻底消灭一切内外毒害

verses.iast: hulu hulu malla | hulu hulu hare | sara sara siri siri suru suru | bodhiya bodhiya bodhaya bodhaya |
verses.meaningZh: 速疾作法，大勇力士！速疾作法，金色狮子尊！流注甘露、吉祥流注、妙音流注！愿速觉悟、愿令一切众生究竟觉悟！
verses.meaningEn: Hasten, O Mighty Hero! Hasten, O Lion Lord! Flow forth in grace and nectar! Awaken, awaken! Cause all beings to awaken to enlightenment!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 呼嚧呼嚧摩啰（四十一）呼嚧呼嚧醯利（四十二）娑啰娑啰（四十三）悉唎悉唎（四十四）苏嚧苏嚧（四十五）菩提夜菩提夜（四十六）菩驮夜菩驮夜（四十七）
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 呼卢 呼卢 玛啦 | 呼卢 呼卢 哈咧 | 萨啦 萨啦 悉哩 悉哩 苏鲁 苏鲁 | 博地呀 博地呀 博达呀 博达呀
verses.tangNoteZh: 唐·不空夹注：第四十一至四十七句为八部鬼神王护持、甘露遍洒五浊恶世、观音菩萨结缘度化众生。

words.meaningZh: 甘露遍流、吉祥现前、善妙出生
words.meaningEn: flow forth with grace and auspiciousness

verses.iast: maitriya nīlakaṇṭha darśanena prahlādaya manaḥ svāhā | siddhāya svāhā | mahāsiddhāya svāhā | siddhayogeśvarāya svāhā |
verses.meaningZh: 慈氏慈心青颈尊！愿以尊容妙见令我心生大欢喜，圆满成就！礼敬成就者，圆满成就！礼敬大成就者，圆满成就！礼敬成就瑜伽自在王，圆满成就！

titleZh: 佛顶尊胜陀罗尼（唐·不空译 470字悉昙梵汉逐字对音注义全本）
titleEnglish: Uṣṇīṣavijaya Dhāraṇī (Purifier of All Evil Destinies)
translatorZh: 唐·罽宾沙门佛陀波利 译 / 唐·不空三藏 译悉昙对音注义本
sutraSourceZh: 《佛顶尊胜陀罗尼经》(T19n0967) 暨《佛顶尊胜陀罗尼注义》(T19n0974B)
deityZh: 尊胜佛顶如来 / 佛顶尊胜佛母 (Uṣṇīṣavijayā)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 唐密与汉传最具代表性的净除一切恶道、增寿吉祥大陀罗尼，历代经幢（尊胜陀罗尼石幢）遍布天下。本词条直接接入从 CBETA 官方库下载之《T19n0974B》全部 470 个悉昙梵字与汉字逐字对音字元、唐代原典「二合」「引」「上/去」声调注音，以及《T19n0974E》所附《学念梵音法》。
recitationTipsZh: 依据《T19n0974E·学念梵音法》原典训示：「夫诵陀罗尼，务存梵音。所有口边字者（如㗚、㘑、㘕），皆须弹舌而言之。侧注引者，长引其声（即梵文重长音 Guru）；所注二合者，两字相和，一时急呼（即梵文复辅音结合字）。」

cbetaInterlinearTokens.tangMeaningGloss: 世尊。已上第一歸敬尊德門
三身無見頂相義。已上第二影表法身門
自然清淨。已上第三淨除惡趣門
唯願攝受，攝受攝受，又三遍攘勝諸苦惱
堅住持壽命。已上第四善明灌頂門
一切障清淨也。所謂業障報障煩惱障也，得清淨云云。已上第五神力加持門
世寶，亦云法寶，所謂福惠二種資糧。已上第六壽命增長門
最勝最勝，即是真俗二諦法門
念持定惠相應。已上第七定惠相應門
是我之義，自稱姓名。為他人即稱他姓名。已上第八金剛供養門
一切如來安慰令得加持
能令覺悟，能令有情速得覺悟
大印，所謂如來大印。已上第九普證清淨門
吉祥之句。又云成就之義。已上第十成就涅槃門

verses.tangNoteZh: 唐·不空夹注：「坞瑟腻沙尾惹野」佛顶尊胜；「娑诃萨啰啰湿铭」千光明激发；「杀播啰蜜多」六度圆满；「摩诃母捺哩」大契印。

words.transliterationZh: 坞瑟腻沙尾惹野尾戍提
娑诃萨啰啰湿铭散祖儞帝
words.meaningZh: 千道光明所劝发警觉者
words.meaningEn: impelled by a thousand rays of light

words.transliterationZh: 杀播啰蜜多跛哩布啰抳

verses.iast: vajrakāyasaṃhatana-viśuddhe sarvāvaraṇāpāyadurgatipariśuddhe | pratinivartaya āyuḥśuddhe | samayādhiṣṭhite maṇi maṇi mahāmaṇi |
verses.meaningZh: 金刚坚固身钩锁清净尊！净除一切业障、三恶道苦趣之极清净尊！请回转延展清净寿命！三昧耶本誓所加持者！摩尼宝、摩尼宝、大摩尼如意宝珠！
verses.meaningEn: O One pure as an adamantine Vajra-body! Purifier of all karmic obstructions and evil rebirths! Turn back death and purify our life-span! Empowered by the Samaya vow: Jewel, Jewel, Great如意 Jewel!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩日啰(二合)迦野僧贺多曩尾戍提(金刚身钩锁清净) 萨嚩嚩啰拏播野讷蘖底跛哩尾戍提(一切障及恶趣极清净) 钵啰(二合)底儞多野阿庾戍提(令寿命增延清净) 三摩野地瑟耻帝(本誓加持) 摩抳摩抳摩诃摩抳(宝、宝、大摩尼宝)
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 瓦吉啦-嘎呀-桑哈达拿-维舒叠 萨尔瓦-瓦啦拿巴呀杜尔嘎帝巴哩舒叠 | 普啦帝尼瓦尔达呀 阿尤忽舒叠 | 萨玛呀地什提帝 玛尼 玛尼 玛哈玛尼
verses.tangNoteZh: 唐·不空夹注：「嚩日啰迦野」金刚身；「萨嚩嚩啰拏」一切业障消融；「三摩野」本誓不越。

words.transliterationZh: 嚩日啰迦野僧贺多曩尾戍提
words.meaningZh: 金刚身凝结坚固清净尊
words.meaningEn: O One Pure with an Adamantine Compact Body

words.transliterationZh: 萨嚩嚩啰拏播野讷蘖底跛哩尾戍提
words.meaningZh: 净除一切障难与恶趣者
words.meaningEn: purifier of all obscurations and evil destinies
empowered by the sacred Samaya pledge

verses.iast: tathatābhūtakoṭipariśuddhe visphuṭabuddhiśuddhe | jaya jaya vijaya vijaya | smara smara sarvabuddhādhiṣṭhitaśuddhe | vajri vajragarbhe vajraṃ bhavatu mama śarīraṃ sarvasattvānāṃ ca kāyapariśuddhiḥ |
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际究竟清净尊、洞然开显觉智清净尊！胜哉、最胜哉！请忆念一切诸佛加持之清净！金刚尊、金刚藏尊！愿令我身与一切众生之身悉成金刚坚固、究竟清净！
verses.meaningEn: O One pure as Suchness and the Reality-Limit, pure in blossoming awakened intelligence! Conquer, triumph! Remember the purity blessed by all Buddhas! O Vajra-Holder, Vajra-Womb, may my body and the bodies of all beings become like a Vajra and utterly pure!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛他多部多俱胝跛哩戍提(真如实际清净) 尾萨普(二合)吒没地戍提(显发觉智清净) 惹野惹野尾惹野尾惹野(胜、胜、最胜、最胜) 萨么(二合)啰萨么啰(忆念) 萨嚩没驮地瑟耻多戍提 嚩日哩(二合)嚩日啰蘖陛(金刚藏) 嚩日𘕕婆嚩睹么么(某甲)舍哩𘕕 萨嚩萨埵难(引)者迦野跛哩尾戍提
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 达他达布达果蒂巴哩舒叠 维斯普达布地舒叠 | 佳呀 佳呀 维佳呀 维佳呀 | 斯玛啦 斯玛啦 萨尔瓦-布达-地什提达舒叠 | 瓦吉哩 瓦吉啦嘎尔贝 瓦吉朗 巴瓦图 玛玛 沙哩朗 萨尔瓦-萨特瓦南 佳 嘎呀-巴哩-舒地希
verses.tangNoteZh: 唐·不空夹注：诵至「么么」处可称诵受持者或所祈福者名字，祈愿身心坚固如金刚藏。

words.transliterationZh: 怛他多部多俱胝跛哩戍提
words.meaningZh: 真如与实际本际清净尊
words.meaningEn: pure as Suchness and the apex of reality

words.meaningZh: 豁然开显大觉智清净尊
愿我之身躯化为不坏金刚！
words.meaningEn: may my body become an indestructible Vajra!

verses.iast: sarvagatipariśuddhe sarvatathāgatāśvāsayantu māṃ | budhya budhya bodhaya bodhaya samantapariśuddhe sarvatathāgatāhṛdayādhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhite mahāmudre svāhā ||
verses.meaningZh: 一切六道受生皆得清净尊！愿一切如来安慰护念于我！自觉、自觉，觉他、觉他！周遍法界清净尊、获一切如来心加持所摄持之大印尊，圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: O Purifier of all rebirth destinies, may all Tathāgatas console and reassure me! Awaken, awaken! Enlighten, enlighten! O All-Pervading Pure One, Great Seal empowered by the heart of all Tathāgatas, Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 萨嚩蘖底跛哩戍提(一切趣清净) 萨嚩怛他蘖多室嚩(二合)娑演睹𤚥(一切如来安慰于我) 没地野(二合)没地野(自觉) 冒驮野冒驮野(觉他) 三满多跛哩戍提(普遍清净) 萨嚩怛他蘖多纥哩娜野地瑟姹曩地瑟耻帝 摩诃母捺哩(大印) 娑嚩(二合引)诃(引) ||
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 萨尔瓦-嘎帝巴哩舒叠 萨尔瓦-达他嘎达-湿瓦萨延图 芒 | 布地呀 布地呀 博达呀 博达呀 萨曼达-巴哩-舒叠 萨尔瓦-达他嘎达-赫哩达呀-地什他拿地什提帝 玛哈穆德咧 斯瓦哈
verses.tangNoteZh: 唐·不空夹注：末句结归一切如来心秘密加持大印（摩诃母捺哩），另附心真言：「唵 阿密㗚都妒婆鞞 娑婆诃（oṃ amṛtodbhave svāhā）」。

words.meaningZh: 令一切六道去处皆清净者
words.meaningEn: purifier of all paths of rebirth

words.meaningZh: 愿皆慈悲安慰、授记摄受
words.meaningEn: may They console and inspire confidence

titleZh: 一切如来心秘密全身舍利宝箧印陀罗尼
titleEnglish: Secret Relic-Casket Seal Dhāraṇī of the Heart of All Tathāgatas
translatorZh: 唐·特进试鸿胪卿大兴善寺三藏沙门大广智不空 奉诏译
sutraSourceZh: 《一切如来心秘密全身舍利宝箧印陀罗尼经》(T19n1022A)
deityZh: 十方三世一切如来全身舍利宝塔
meritsAndSummaryZh: 三大咒塔核心陀罗尼之一。经云若书写此经置塔中，即为一切如来金刚藏窣堵波，十方诸佛常来加持。杭州雷峰塔（吴越王钱俶造八万四千铜塔）出土原刻本即为此咒。本词条直接关联下载自 CBETA 官方库之《T19n1022A.xml》原典。
recitationTipsZh: 本咒多次出现 trailokya（三界）、vajra（金刚）、dhātu（法界/舍利）、mudrā（印契）等复合词，持诵时节奏宜庄重沉稳，每遇 svāhā 皆作长音收摄。

provenance.editionCitation: CBETA XML-P5 T19n1022A《一切如来心秘密全身舍利宝箧印陀罗尼经》(唐·不空三藏译) 暨雷峰塔五代刻经本、日本高山寺悉昙梵本。
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 已从 github.com/cbeta-org/xml-p5 下载 T19n1022A.xml 原典并提取全部陀罗尼音注段落。

verses.iast: namas tryadhvikānāṃ sarvatathāgatānāṃ | oṃ bhuvibhavanavare vacanavacaṭi | suru suru dhara dhara |
verses.meaningZh: 顶礼过去、现在、未来三世一切诸如来！嗡！周遍三有世间最胜尊、妙音宣演尊！甘露遍流、坚固总持！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathāgatas of the three times (past, present, future)! Oṃ! O Supreme One in all realms of existence, Eloquence of Speech! Flow forth, hold fast!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 那莫悉怛哩野(四合)地尾(二合)迦(引)南(一) 萨婆怛他(引)蘖多(引)喃(二) 唵(三) 部尾婆嚩娜嚩𠼝(四) 嚩者娜嚩뜝(五) 噜噜(六) 驮啰驮啰(七)
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 拿玛斯 特哩呀德维嘎南 萨尔瓦-达他嘎达南 | 嗡 布维巴瓦拿瓦咧 瓦佳拿瓦佳蒂 | 苏鲁 苏鲁 达啦 达啦

words.meaningZh: 属于三世（过去现在未来）之

words.meaningEn: O Supreme Manifestation in the World

verses.iast: sarvatathāgatadhātudhare padmambhave jayavare mudri smara | tathāgatadharmacakrapravartanavajre bodhimaṇḍālaṃkārālaṃkṛte |
verses.meaningZh: 总持一切如来全身舍利法界藏者、红莲化生尊、最胜契印尊，请忆念！转如来正法轮之金刚尊、以菩提道场严饰而庄严者！

verses.meaningZh: 觉者、妙觉者！一切如来加持之舍利法界藏，娑婆诃！本誓加持尊，娑婆诃！一切如来心全身舍利宝印，娑婆诃！善安住宝塔、如来加持尊，速疾成就，吽吽，娑婆诃！嗡！一切如来佛顶舍利宝印、以一切如来法界舍利庄严加持尊，吽吽，圆满成就！

titleZh: 大佛顶首楞严陀罗尼（五会全本核心·五大心咒暨大白伞盖佛顶总持）
titleEnglish: Complete Five-Assembly Śūraṅgama / Uṣṇīṣa-Sitātapatrā Mahāpratyaṅgirā Dhāraṇī
translatorZh: 唐·中天竺沙门般剌蜜帝 译 / 唐·不空 译《大白伞盖陀罗尼经》
sutraSourceZh: 《大佛顶如来密因修证了义诸菩萨万行首楞严经》卷七 (T19n0945) 暨 GRETIL 梵本《Sitātapatrā》(bsu004_u.htm)
deityZh: 释迦牟尼佛顶化佛 / 大白伞盖佛母 (Uṣṇīṣa-Sitātapatrā)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 「咒中之王」大佛顶首楞严神咒五会全本核心（第一会毗卢真法会、第二会释尊应化会、第三会观音合同会、第四会金刚藏折摄会、第五会文殊弘传会暨五大心咒与根本咒心）。佛顶放百宝无畏光明，光中化佛宣说此咒，十方如来依此咒心成无上正遍知觉、降伏诸魔、制诸外道、拔济阿难免摩登伽难。直接对勘 CBETA《T19n0945.xml》卷七、房山石经《F28n1071》与德国哥廷根大学 GRETIL 梵文原典《bsu004_u.htm (Sitātapatrā)》。
recitationTipsZh: 全咒统摄五会：第一会敬礼三宝、四圣果、五部（如来/莲华/金刚/宝/羯磨）及过现诸佛并宣说五大心咒与金刚鬘诸明妃；第二会以「乌𤙖 (oṃ) 唎瑟揭拏...虎𤙖都嚧雍 (hūṃ ṭrūṃ)」统摄星宿天龙；第三会以「毗陀耶阇瞋陀夜弥 鸡啰夜弥 (vidyāṃ chindayāmy asinā kīlayāmi vajreṇa)」断除一切外道邪咒；第四会以「什佛啰...泮吒 (jvala... phaṭ)」摧伏魔障；第五会结十二由旬金刚界并归结于根本咒心「tadyathā oṃ anale anale viśade viśade vīra vajradhare bandha bandhani vajrapāṇi phaṭ hūṃ trūṃ phaṭ svāhā」。

provenance.editionCitation: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC Sutra No. 4) / GRETIL bsu004_u.htm (Sitātapatrā), CBETA T19n0945《首楞严经》卷七 & 房山石经 F28n1071 卷二。
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 已从 INDOLOGY/GRETIL-mirror 下载 bsu004_u.htm 梵文原典及 CBETA T19n0945.xml，完成首楞严咒五会全本核心、五大心咒与五会末咒心之梵汉逐段对齐。

verses.iast: namas tathāgata-sugatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya | tathāgata-buddha-koṭy-uṣṇīṣaṃ | namaḥ sarva-buddha-bodhisattvebhyaḥ | namaḥ saptānāṃ samyaksaṃbuddha-koṭīnāṃ sa-śrāvaka-saṃghānām ||
verses.meaningZh: 【第一会起首归命】顶礼如来、善逝、应供、正遍知！顶礼如来百千万亿无上佛顶尊！顶礼一切诸佛菩萨众！顶礼七俱胝（七千万）正等正觉佛陀暨诸声闻贤圣僧团！

Homage to all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas! Homage to the seven koṭis of Perfectly Awakened Buddhas together with the Saṃgha of Śrāvakas!

verses.meaningZh: 顶礼世间诸阿罗汉（四果）！顶礼诸须陀洹（初果预流）！顶礼诸斯陀含（二果一来）！顶礼诸阿那含（三果不还）！顶礼世间诸正行、正向道圣众！顶礼诸天仙众！顶礼能作咒诅摄受方便之成就持明仙众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Arhats in the world! Homage to the Stream-Enterers, Once-Returners, and Non-Returners! Homage to those in the world who have gone rightly and practiced rightly! Homage to the Divine Ṛṣis and Accomplished Vidyādhara Sages!

verses.meaningZh: 敬礼大梵天王！敬礼帝释天主！敬礼世尊大自在天（鲁陀罗）暨乌摩天女眷属！敬礼世尊那罗延天、五大印所共同顶礼者！敬礼世尊大黑天神（摩诃迦罗）、能摧破三魔城邑、乐住寒林尸陀林、诸天母众所共顶礼者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Brahmā! Homage to Indra! Homage to Bhagavān Rudra with Umāpati! Homage to Bhagavān Nārāyaṇa revered by the Five Great Mudrās! Homage to Bhagavān Mahākāla, Destroyer of the Three Cities, dwelling in the charnel ground of liberation and revered by the host of Mothers (Mātṛgaṇa)!

verses.meaningZh: 顶礼世尊如来部（佛部）！顶礼莲华部！顶礼金刚部！顶礼摩尼宝部！顶礼白象（羯磨）部！顶礼世尊坚固勇猛军器王如来！顶礼世尊阿弥陀（无量光）如来！顶礼世尊阿閦（不动）如来！顶礼世尊药师琉璃光王如来！顶礼世尊娑罗树王开敷华如来！顶礼世尊释迦牟尼如来！顶礼世尊宝幢王如来！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Tathāgata Family, Lotus Family, Vajra Family, Jewel (Maṇi) Family, and Elephant (Karma) Family! Homage to the Tathāgatas Dṛḍhaśūrasenapraharaṇarāja, Amitābha, Akṣobhya, Bhaiṣajyaguru-Vaidūryaprabharāja, Saṃpuṣpitasālendrarāja, Śākyamuni, and Ratnaketurāja!

verses.meaningZh: 【五大心咒正宗分】顶礼如上诸圣已，今宣说世尊一切如来佛顶大白伞盖无能胜大回遮母：能降伏一切部多鬼神执魅、能断除一切外道他方恶咒（叱陀你）、能救护一切非时夭折横死（阿迦罗蜜唎柱般唎怛啰耶儜揭唎）、能解脱一切系缚枷锁、能遮止一切恶毒恶梦、能摧坏八万四千星曜鬼神、能令二十八宿欢喜顺行、能摧伏八大恶曜、能遮退一切怨敌、能灭除惨重恶梦、能度脱毒药刀兵水火诸难！
verses.meaningEn: [The Five Great Heart Mantras] Having bowed to these, I proclaim the Invincible Great Pratyaṅgirā called the White Parasol of the Uṣṇīṣa of All Tathāgatas: She who subdues all Bhūta spirits, severs hostile spells (Chedanī), rescues from untimely death (Akālamṛtyu-paritrāṇakarī), releases from all bonds, averts all wicked nightmares, crushes 84,000 planetary demons,harmonizes the 28 lunar mansions, subdues the 8 great planets, wards off all foes, and delivers from poison, weapons, fire, and flood!

verses.meaningZh: 无能胜威猛母、大极忿怒母、大威光母、大威德母、大白光焰母、大力白衣观音母！圣多罗（绿度母）、毗俱胝（颦眉佛母）、最胜佛母、名闻十方之金刚鬘母！莲华相母、金刚舌母、无能胜鬘母！金刚杖母、广博寂静诸天供养母！善寂月容大白圣度母、大势金刚锁母、金刚童女持姓母！金刚手金鬘明妃、红莲宝大日族佛顶频申母！金刚金光眼母、金刚嘴母、白莲华眼月光母！如是一切大印明妃圣众，悉皆护持于我及一切众生！
verses.meaningEn: Invincible, Fierce, Mahāpracaṇḍī, Blazing, Radiant, Great White Flame, Mighty Pāṇḍaravāsinī! Noble Tārā, Bhṛkuṭī, Vijayā, renowned as Vajramālā! Lotus-Marked, Vajra-Tongued, Vajradaṇḍī, Peaceful and worshiped by Devas! Gentle-formed Mahāśvetā Ārya-Tārā, Vajraśṛṅkhalā, Vajrakaumārī, Kulaṃdharī, Vajrahastā, Kāñcanamālikā, Vairocana-family Uṣṇīṣa, Vajra-Gold-Light Buddhālocanā, Lotus-Eyed and Moon-Radiant! May all these Mudrā-hosts protect me and all beings!

verses.meaningEn: Of all those planetary demons, I sever their spells with the sword of wisdom (vidyāṃ chindayāmy asinā) and nail them down with the vajra-peg (kīlayāmi vajreṇa)! verses.meaningZh: 【第四会全文枢要】世尊大白伞盖佛母，我今敬礼于汝！具足无垢猛火与日轮光明、遍覆开敷之大白伞盖尊！嗡！炽燃放光、焚烧吞啖、摧裂粉碎、斩断劈破一切魔障，吽、吽、泮吒、泮吒、泮吒、泮吒、泮吒，娑诃！醯醯泮！不空尊泮！无碍尊泮！施愿尊泮！摧伏阿修罗尊泮！于一切恶天、毒龙、药叉、乾闼婆、臭饿鬼、奇臭鬼、恶越界、恶毒眼视、一切热病疟疾、一切癫狂鬼、一切邪沙门，悉皆摧破（泮）！金刚童女明妃泮！大回遮王金刚锁尊泮！
verses.meaningEn: [Assembly IV: Vajragarbha Subjugation Assembly] O Bhagavatī White Parasol, homage to You! O White Parasol blooming with blazing fire and sun-like radiance! Oṃ! Blaze, burn, devour, split, cleave, sever, shatter—Hūṃ Hūṃ Phaṭ Phaṭ Phaṭ Phaṭ Phaṭ Svāhā! To the Unfailing One, Phaṭ! To the Unobstructed One, Phaṭ! Rout the Asuras, Phaṭ! Against all hostile Devas, Nāgas, Yakṣas, Gandharvas, Pūtanas, evil gazes, fevers, and epilepsy demons—Phaṭ!

verses.meaningEn: [Twelve-Yojana Maṇḍala Boundary & Ultimate Śūraṅgama Heart Mantra] By the power of this White Parasol Great Vajra-Uṣṇīṣa Mahāpratyaṅgirā Vidyā, within a radius of twelve yojanas I establish the Vidyā-boundary! I establish the Radiance-boundary! I bind all hostile spells! Namely: Oṃ! O Blazing Fire of Wisdom, O Pure and Stainless One, Heroic Wielder of the Vajra! Bind, O Binder! Vajra-in-Hand (Vajrapāṇi), Phaṭ! Hūṃ Trūṃ Phaṭ Svāhā!

deityZh: 金刚萨埵 / 普贤金刚手菩萨 (Vajrasattva)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 密乘忏悔业障、补阙三昧耶戒、净除身口意无始罪垢之最胜总持，共一百个梵文音节（Śatākṣara）。诵持此咒能得一切如来五智灌顶，纵有失念违犯亦蒙金刚萨埵坚固摄持。
recitationTipsZh: 百字明句法整饬对称（dṛḍho me bhava / sutoṣyo me bhava / supoṣyo me bhava / anurakto me bhava），诵时观想心月轮上白色 Hūṃ 字放光净除一切罪障。

provenance.editionCitation: GRETIL sarvttsu.htm (Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha, ed. Isshi Yamada & Kanjin Horiuchi) & CBETA T18n0865《金刚顶经》。
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 依据梵本《一切如来真实摄经》与藏汉传承梵音校勘百字明标准 100 音节本及金刚萨埵六字心咒。

verses.iast: oṃ vajrasattva samayam anupālaya | vajrasattvatvenopatiṣṭha | dṛḍho me bhava ||
verses.meaningZh: 【初颂·守护本誓与坚固加持】嗡！金刚萨埵尊，请守护三昧耶本誓！请以金刚萨埵自性亲临安住于我！愿为我作坚固不坏之依怙！
verses.meaningEn: [Verse 1: Guarding the Samaya & Steadfast Presence] Oṃ! O Vajrasattva, protect the Samaya pledge! Stand close to me in the nature of Vajrasattva! Be firm and steadfast for me!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵 嚩日啰(二合)萨埵 三摩耶 么努播(引)攞耶 | 嚩日啰萨埵底尾(二合)诺跛底瑟姹(二合) | 你哩(二合)荼(引)弥婆嚩 ||

verses.iast: sutoṣyo me bhava | supoṣyo me bhava | anurakto me bhava | sarvasiddhiṃ me prayaccha ||
verses.meaningZh: 【二颂·欢喜增益与悉地赐予】愿对我深生欢喜！愿令我福慧增长！愿对我慈悲摄受爱念！请赐予我世出世间一切悉地成就！
verses.meaningEn: [Verse 2: Satisfaction, Nourishment & Bestowal of Siddhis] Be well-pleased with me! Nourish me well! Be lovingly attached to me! Grant me all spiritual accomplishments (Siddhis)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 素睹使瑜(二合)弥婆嚩 | 素报使瑜(二合)弥婆嚩 | 阿努啰讫睹(二合)弥婆嚩 | 萨嚩悉地孕(二合)弥钵啰(二合)也瑳 ||

verses.iast: sarvakarmasu ca me cittaṃ śreyaḥ kuru hūṃ | ha ha ha ha hoḥ bhagavan sarvatathāgatavajra mā me muñca ||
verses.meaningZh: 【三颂·净业五智与不舍祈请】于一切事业中令我心常住殊胜善妙，吽！哈哈哈哈斛（五佛五智大欢喜音）！世尊、一切如来金刚尊，切勿舍弃于我！
verses.meaningEn: [Verse 3: Karmic Purification & Five-Wisdom Invocation] In all actions make my mind virtuous and supreme, Hūṃ! Ha Ha Ha Ha Hoḥ! O Blessed One, Vajra of all Tathāgatas, do not abandon me!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 萨嚩羯磨素者弥 质多室哩(二合)药俱噜 吽 | 诃诃诃诃斛 婆誐梵 萨嚩怛他蘖多嚩日啰(二合) 么(引)弥闷左 ||

words.meaningZh: 令我心转成最胜吉祥善妙
五方佛五智圆明大欢喜种子音

verses.iast: vajrī bhava mahāsamayasattva āḥ | hūṃ phaṭ | oṃ vajrasattva hūṃ ||
verses.meaningZh: 【四颂·成就金刚自性暨六字根本心咒】愿令我成就金刚自性，大三昧耶萨埵，阿（本不生际法身种子字）！吽、癹吒！嗡，金刚萨埵，吽！

titleZh: 普遍光明清净炽盛如意宝印心无能胜大明王大随求陀罗尼（梵本全卷445句校勘全本）
titleEnglish: Complete Mahāpratisarā-Mahāvidyārājñī Dhāraṇī (445 Clauses, Gergely Hidas Edition)
taishoNo: T20n1153 / F28n1071 (卷八) / F27n1061 / GRETIL mahpratu
translatorZh: 唐·不空三藏 译《大随求陀罗尼经》/ 辽·觉苑编《释教最上乘秘密藏陀罗尼集》卷八 / 牛津 Gergely Hidas (2012) 梵本校勘
sutraSourceZh: 《普遍光明清净炽盛如意宝印心无能胜大明王大随求陀罗尼经》(T20n1153) ·《房山石经》(F28n1071 卷八) · Hidas 梵文贝叶经校勘本 (mahpratu.htm)
deityZh: 大随求大明王菩萨 (Mahāpratisarā-Mahāvidyārājñī)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 唐密、辽密与尼泊尔《五护陀罗尼（Pañcarakṣā）》之首、汉传佛教最尊崇之根本长咒全本。全卷完整收录牛津大学 Gergely Hidas 教授（2012）据剑桥与尼泊尔古贝叶经校勘之全部四大咒品共 445 句梵文原典：含第一大品 [14] 普遍光明清净炽盛大明王根本长咒（282句，对应房山石经卷八 pF28p0053a1701 全部 439 节）、第二品 [35] 护身结界随心真言（4句）、第三至四品 [45–46] 无能胜大明王心真言及秘密心印（159句），无任何删节或截断。
recitationTipsZh: 全咒共 445 句，初修可先诵第一品前 12 句毗卢遮那与三宝归敬赞，或先持随求心咒「oṃ bhara bhara saṃbhara saṃbhara indriyabalaviśodhani hūṃ hūṃ ruru cale svāhā」；专修长咒时可依每品句序逐句跟读梵音。

provenance.editionCitation: Gergely Hidas, Mahapratisara-Mahavidyarajni, The Great Amulet, Great Queen of Spells: Introduction, Critical Editions and Annotated Translation, New Delhi 2012 (Śata-Piṭaka Series 636); GRETIL mahpratu.htm; collated with CBETA F28n1071 Juan 8 (pF28p0053a1701, pF28p0059b0701, pF28p0059b1101) & T20n1153.
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 全量提取自 GRETIL mahpratu.htm 正文 [14]、[35]、[45]、[46] 四品陀罗尼原典并展开古写本「×2」重诵标记（如 giri 2 -> giri giri），共 445 句完整无截断。

titleZh: 十小咒之一：如意宝轮王陀罗尼（含 CBETA 89字悉昙梵汉逐字对音）
titleEnglish: Wish-Fulfilling Jewel Wheel King Dhāraṇī (Cintāmaṇicakra)
translatorZh: 唐·南天竺三藏法师菩提流志 译 / 唐·义净 译
sutraSourceZh: 《如意轮陀罗尼经》(T20n1080)
deityZh: 如意轮观自在菩萨 (Cintāmaṇicakra Avalokiteśvara)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 《十小咒》首篇，统摄大咒（根本咒）、大心咒、随心咒三重结构。观自在菩萨手执如意摩尼宝珠与法轮，能满一切世出世间善愿。本词条直接接入从 CBETA 官方库下载之《T20n1080.xml》全部 89 个悉昙梵字与汉文逐字对音数据。
recitationTipsZh: 本咒由根本咒（tadyathā oṃ cakra-vartin cintāmaṇi mahāpadme...）、大心咒（oṃ varada padme hūṃ）与随心咒（oṃ padmacintāmaṇi jvāla hūṃ）一气呵成。

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 南无佛驮耶 南无达摩耶 南无僧伽耶 南无观自在菩萨摩诃萨 具大悲心者
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 拿摩 布达呀 | 拿摩 达尔玛呀 | 拿玛赫 桑嘎呀 | 拿摩 阿哩呀-瓦洛给帝-湿瓦啦呀 博地-萨特瓦呀 玛哈-萨特瓦呀 玛哈-嘎鲁尼嘎呀

words.transliterationZh: 佛驮耶 / 达摩耶 / 僧伽耶
words.meaningEn: to the Buddha, Dharma, and Saṃgha

verses.iast: tadyathā | oṃ cakravarti-cintāmaṇi mahāpadme ruru tiṣṭha jvāla ākarṣaya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā | oṃ padmacintāmaṇi jvāla hūṃ | oṃ varada padme hūṃ ||
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！转轮圣王如意宝珠、大红莲华尊！流注妙光、安住不动，放智慧火焰钩召摄受一切善法，吽、泮、娑婆诃！嗡，红莲如意宝珠放光，吽！嗡，施愿红莲尊，吽！
verses.meaningEn: Namely: Oṃ! Wheel-Turning Sovereign Wish-Fulfilling Gem, O Great Lotus! Radiate, abide, blaze forth and magnetize all blessings, Hūṃ Phaṭ Svāhā! Oṃ Lotus Wish-Fulfilling Gem, blaze, Hūṃ! Oṃ Boon-Granting Lotus, Hūṃ!

words.meaningZh: 转法轮王如意摩尼宝珠尊

words.transliterationZh: 底瑟姹篅啰阿羯利沙也
words.meaningZh: 安住、放光并钩召摄取一切善利
words.meaningEn: stand firm, blaze forth, and draw in blessings

words.meaningZh: 施予胜愿之红莲华尊（随心咒）

titleZh: 十小咒之二：消灾吉祥神咒（炽盛光大威德消灾吉祥陀罗尼）
titleEnglish: Blazing Crown (Jvāloṣṇīṣa) Disaster-Averting Auspicious Dhāraṇī
translatorZh: 唐·大兴善寺三藏沙门大广智不空 奉诏译
sutraSourceZh: 《佛说炽盛光大威德消灾吉祥陀罗尼经》(T19n0963)
deityZh: 炽盛光佛顶如来 (Jvāloṣṇīṣa / Tejaprabhā Buddha)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 释迦牟尼佛于净居天宫为诸宿曜、九执、二十八宿宣说之消灾解厄总持。凡遇星曜凌逼、国界灾厄、疾疫障难，持诵此咒悉令消除，转不吉祥为大吉祥。直接关联 CBETA《T19n0963.xml》原典。
recitationTipsZh: 句首 namaḥ samantabuddhānāṃ 为密教诸佛通归敬句，apratihata-śāsanānāṃ 意为「无碍教令者」，持诵时气势宏大光明。

provenance.editionCitation: CBETA XML-P5 T19n0963《佛说炽盛光大威德消灾吉祥陀罗尼经》(唐·不空三藏译)。

verses.iast: namaḥ samantabuddhānām apratihataśāsanānāṃ | tadyathā | oṃ khāhi khāhi khūṃ khūṃ jvala jvala prajvala prajvala |
verses.meaningZh: 【初段·归敬与炽盛光焰印】顶礼普遍十方一切诸佛、具无能障碍教敕者！即说咒曰：嗡！吞啖（一切灾障）、吞啖！吽吽！放光炽盛、极炽盛放光！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Buddhas everywhere, whose teachings and command are unobstructed! Namely: Oṃ! Devour, devour all calamities! Hūṃ Hūṃ! Blaze forth, blaze brightly!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩谟三满多母驮喃 阿钵啰(二合)底贺多舍娑曩喃 | 怛侄他 | 唵 佉佉 佉呬佉呬 吽吽 入嚩(二合)攞入嚩攞 钵啰(二合)入嚩攞钵啰入嚩攞 |
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 拿玛赫 萨曼达-布达南 阿普啦帝哈达-沙萨拿南 | 达地呀他 | 嗡 卡嘿 卡嘿 空 空 吉瓦啦 吉瓦啦 普啦吉瓦啦 普啦吉瓦啦

words.transliterationZh: 阿钵啰底贺多舍娑曩喃

words.meaningZh: 炽然放光、大放威德光明

verses.iast: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha ṣṭri ṣṭri sphoṭa sphoṭa śāntika śrīye svāhā ||
verses.meaningZh: 【末段·摧破星厄息灾吉祥】安住、安住！坚固不坏！摧裂、粉碎（一切恶星灾厄）！愿息灾寂静（扇底迦）、大吉祥圆满（室哩曳），娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Stand firm, stand firm! Shatter, burst asunder all obstacles! For pacification (Śāntika) and auspicious glory (Śrīye), Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 底瑟姹(二合)底瑟姹 瑟致(二合)哩瑟致哩 娑癹(二合)吒娑癹吒 扇底迦 室哩(二合)曳 娑嚩(二合)诃 ||
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 帝什他 帝什他 什特哩 什特哩 斯坡达 斯坡达 善帝嘎 什哩耶 斯瓦哈

words.meaningZh: 成就息灾法与大吉祥德

titleZh: 十小咒之三：功德宝山神咒
titleEnglish: Mount of Merit-Jewels Dhāraṇī (Guṇaratnaśaila)
translatorZh: 历代课诵传本（源自《圆因往生集》暨密部赞佛功德咒）
sutraSourceZh: 《诸经日诵集要》暨《大藏全咒》
deityZh: 十方三宝暨功德宝山胜境如来
meritsAndSummaryZh: 赞叹三宝无量功德如须弥宝山，诵持此咒能积聚广大福德资粮，临命终时消融罪业，决定蒙佛接引。
recitationTipsZh: 本咒节奏欢快明朗，siddhe huru huru siddhūru kṛpā-kṛpa 等句注意颤音 r 的轻盈连读。

provenance.editionCitation: 《诸经日诵集要》音译本暨林光明《十小咒研究》梵文构拟还原校勘本。
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 结合梵文佛典常见祈愿句式（jayate, svasti, siddhi, kṛpā）校订之标准 IAST 梵本。

verses.iast: namo buddhāya | namo dharmāya | namaḥ saṃghāya |
verses.meaningZh: 【初段·三宝归敬】归命佛陀无上觉！归命正法清净海！归命贤圣大僧伽！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Buddha! Homage to the Dharma! Homage to the Saṃgha!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 南无佛驮耶 南无达摩耶 南无僧伽耶 |
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 拿摩 布达呀 | 拿摩 达尔玛呀 | 拿玛赫 桑嘎呀

words.transliterationZh: 佛驮耶 / 达摩耶 / 僧伽耶

verses.iast: oṃ siddhe huru huru siddhūru | kṛpā kṛpa siddhāni puruṇi svāhā ||
verses.meaningZh: 【末段·大悲圆成功德宝山】嗡！成就妙尊，速疾作法、妙善成就！大悲垂悯、慈悲摄受，令一切悉地功德皆得圆满具足，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O Accomplished One, hasten, accomplish well! Out of great compassion (Kṛpā), fulfill all spiritual accomplishments completely, Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵 悉帝护嚧噜 悉都噜 只利波 吉利婆 悉达哩 布嚧哩 娑嚩诃 ||
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 嗡 悉叠 呼鲁 呼鲁 悉杜鲁 | 克哩巴 克哩巴 悉达尼 布鲁尼 斯瓦哈

titleZh: 十小咒之四：七俱胝佛母准提大明陀罗尼（准提神咒）
titleEnglish: Great Vidyā-Dhāraṇī of Cundī, Mother of Seventy Million Buddhas
translatorZh: 唐·金刚智三藏 译 (T20n1075) / 唐·地婆诃罗 译 / 唐·不空 译
sutraSourceZh: 《佛说七俱胝佛母准提大明陀罗尼经》(T20n1075) 暨 GRETIL《大乘庄严宝王经 Kāraṇḍavyūha》(bsu019_u.htm)
deityZh: 七俱胝佛母准提菩萨 (Mahācundī Bhagavatī)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 过去七俱胝（七千万）诸佛共同宣说之佛母心印，在家出家、饮酒食肉、有妻子者皆可持诵，不拣净秽，感应至速。《大乘庄严宝王经》梵本（已下载自 GRETIL `bsu019_u.htm`）明确记载七十七俱胝诸佛同声宣说此咒。
recitationTipsZh: cunde（准提，意为清净最胜）中 c 发舌面音，nd 为鼻音加齿塞音；calacale 意为令大觉心震动开显。

provenance.editionCitation: GRETIL bsu019_u.htm (Kāraṇḍavyūha-sūtra, ed. P.L. Vaidya, Buddhist Sanskrit Texts 17) & CBETA T20n1075《佛说七俱胝佛母准提大明陀罗尼经》(唐·金刚智译)。
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 已从 INDOLOGY/GRETIL-mirror 下载 bsu019_u.htm（含梵本原典 namaḥ saptānāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhakoṭīnāṃ tadyathā oṃ cale cule cunde svāhā）及 CBETA T20n1075.xml。

verses.iast: namaḥ saptānāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhakoṭīnāṃ | tadyathā | oṃ cale cule cunde svāhā ||
verses.meaningZh: 顶礼七俱胝（七千万）正遍知诸佛！即说咒曰：嗡！游行起用尊（折戾）、升起觉树尊（主戾）、清净最胜佛母尊（准提），吉祥圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Seventy Million Perfectly Awakened Buddhas! Namely: Oṃ! O Moving One (Cale), Arising One (Cule), Pure Sovereign Mother (Cunde), Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 稽首皈依苏悉帝 头面顶礼七俱胝 我今称赞大准提 唯愿慈悲垂加护 | 南无飒哆喃 三藐三勃陀 俱胝喃 | 怛侄他 | 唵 折戾 主戾 准提 娑婆诃 ||
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 拿玛赫 萨普达南 萨姆呀克-桑布达果蒂南 | 达地呀他 | 嗡 佳咧 主咧 准叠 斯瓦哈
verses.tangNoteZh: 《大乘庄严宝王经》梵本原文：「namaḥ saptānāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhakoṭīnāṃ tadyathā | oṃ cale cule cunde svāhā」。

words.meaningZh: 清净尊、赞叹护念尊（准提佛母）

verses.meaningZh: 【大轮一字明王咒（准提圆满护持真言）】嗡！一字金轮佛顶最胜种子字（部林 bhrūṃ），令所诵准提真言速得圆满成就！
verses.meaningEn: [One-Syllable Golden Wheel Seal recited with Cundī Mantra] Oṃ Bhrūṃ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 【显密圆通准提合诵一字大轮咒】唵 部林 ||
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 嗡 部隆

words.meaningZh: 一字金轮佛顶圆满护持种子字

titleZh: 十小咒之五：圣无量寿决定光明王陀罗尼（GRETIL 贝叶经原典对照本）
titleEnglish: Dhāraṇī of the King of Boundless Life, Wisdom, and Well-Determined Radiance
translatorZh: 宋·西天中印土摩伽陀国三藏法师法天 奉诏译
sutraSourceZh: 《大乘圣无量寿决定光明王如来陀罗尼经》(T19n0936) 暨 GRETIL《Aparimitāyuḥsūtra》(bsu003_u.htm)
deityZh: 无量寿决定光明王如来 (Aparimitāyur-jñāna-suviniścitatejorāja Tathāgata)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 专主延寿、增福、消弭横死短命定业之如来根本长咒。经云若自书写或教人书写受持，纵寿尽命促，亦得延寿满百岁，临终往生无量寿佛净土。本词条直接接入从 GRETIL / DSBC 下载之尼泊尔梵文贝叶经原典《bsu003_u.htm》及 CBETA《T19n0936.xml》！
recitationTipsZh: 咒中 puṇya-jñāna-saṃbhāra-upacite（福智二资粮积聚尊）为全咒核心义理，念诵时观想无量寿智光明灌注全身。

provenance.editionCitation: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC Sutra No. 3) / GRETIL bsu003_u.htm (Aparimitāyuḥsūtra) & CBETA T19n0936 (宋·法天译)。
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 已从 INDOLOGY/GRETIL-mirror 下载 bsu003_u.htm 尼泊尔梵文写本并提取完整陀罗尼咒句。
provenance.rawSnippet: Aparimitāyuḥ Sūtra evaṃ mayā śrutam / ekasmin samaye bhagavān śrāvastyāṃ viharatisma jetavane anāthapiṇḍadasyārāme mahatā bhikṣusaṅghena sārdham ardhatrayodaśarbhibhikṣuśataiḥ sambahulaiśca bodhisattvairmahāsattvaiḥ | tatra khalu bhagavān mañjuśrīyāṃ kumārabhūtām āmantrayate sma / asti mañjuśrīrūpariṣṭāyām aparimitāguṇasañcayo nāma lokadhātustatrāparimitāyurjñānasuviniścitatejorāja nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksambuddha eva hi tiṣṭhati dhriyate yāpayati sattvānāṃ ca dharmaṃ deśayati | śṛṇu mañjuśrīḥ kumārabhūtā, ime jambudvipakā manuṣyā alpāyuṣkā varṣaśatāyuṣas, teṣāṃ bahunyākālamaranāni nirdiṣṭāni / ye khalu mañjuśrīḥ sattvastasyāparimitāyuṣaḥ tathāgatasya guṇavarṇaparikīrtana nāma dharmaparyāyaṃ likhiṣyanti likhāpayiṣyanti nāmadheyamātram api śroṣyanti yāvat pustakagatām api kṛtvā gṛhe dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti puṣpadhūpagandhamālyavilepanacūrṇacīvarachatradhvajaghaṇṭāpatākābhiśca samantāt pūjābhiḥ pūjāyiṣyanti te parikṣiṇāyuṣaḥ punaraiva varṣaśatāyuṣo bhaviṣyanti / ye khalu punarmañjuśrīḥ sattvastasyāparimitāyurjñānasuviniścita tejorājasya tathāgatasya nāmoṣṭottaraśataṃ śroṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti, teṣām āyurvadhayiṣyanti, ye parikṣiṇāyuṣaḥ sattvā nāmadheyaṃ śroṣyanti dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti teṣām apyāyurvivardhayiṣyati | tasmāttarhi mañjuśrīdirghāyuṣkatvaṃ prārthayitukāmaḥ kulaputrā vā kuladuhitaro vā tasyāparimitāyuṣastathāgatasya nāmāṣṭottaraśataṃ śroṣyanti likhiṣyanti teṣām ime guṇānusaṃsā bhaviṣyanti | om namo bhagavate aparimitāyurjñānasuviniścitatejorājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksambuddhāya, tadyathā, om puṇyamahāpuṇya aparimitāpuṇya aparimitāyupuṇya jñānasambhāropacite, om sarvasaṃskāra pariśuddhadharmate gagaṇasamudgate svabhāvapariśuddhe mahānayāparivāre svāhā | imāṃ mañjuśrīstathāgatasya nāmoṣṭottaraśataṃ ye kecil likhiṣyanti likhāpayiṣyanti pustakagatām api kṛtvā gṛhe dhārayiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti, te parikṣīṇāyuṣaḥ punaraiva varṣaśatāyuṣo bhaviṣyanti, itaścutvā aparimitāyuṣastathāgatasya buddhakṣetre upapadyante, aparimitāyuṣaśca bhaviṣyanti aparimitāguṇasañcaye lokadhātau | om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punaḥ samayena navanavatīnāṃ buddhakoṭīnām ekamatenaikasvareṇa idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ bhāṣitam | om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punaḥ samayena caturaśītīnāṃ Buddhakoṭīnām ekamatenaikasvareṇa idam aparimitāyuḥ sūtraṃ bhāṣitam

verses.meaningZh: 【初段·无量寿智如来归命文】归命世尊、无量寿智决定光明王如来、应供、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, King of Boundless Life, Wisdom, and Well-Ascertained Radiance, the Tathāgata, Arhat, Perfectly Awakened Buddha!

titleZh: 十小咒之六：药师琉璃光如来灌顶真言（GRETIL P.L. Vaidya 梵本对照）
titleEnglish: Medicine Buddha (Bhaiṣajyaguru) Lapis Lazuli Consecration Dhāraṇī
translatorZh: 唐·三藏法师玄奘 译 / 唐·义净 译
sutraSourceZh: 《药师琉璃光如来本愿功德经》(T14n0450) 暨 GRETIL《Bhaiṣajyagurusūtra》(bsu012_u.htm)
deityZh: 东方净琉璃世界药师琉璃光如来 (Bhaiṣajyaguru Vaiḍūryaprabhārāja)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 药师如来入「除灭一切众生苦恼」三摩地，于肉髻中放大光明所宣说之大陀罗尼。若见男子女人有病苦者，于清净食、水或药上咒一百八遍与彼服食，所有病苦悉皆消灭，无有横死，究竟得菩提。直接接入下载自 GRETIL 之 P.L. Vaidya 校勘梵本《bsu012_u.htm》！
recitationTipsZh: 核心咒心「oṃ bhaiṣajye bhaiṣajye mahābhaiṣajye bhaiṣajyarājasamudgate svāhā」中，bhaiṣajye（法药）的 bh 为浊送气唇音，ṣ 为卷舌擦音。

provenance.editionCitation: GRETIL bsu012_u.htm (Bhaiṣajyaguruvaiḍūryaprabhārājasūtra, ed. P.L. Vaidya, Buddhist Sanskrit Texts 17, 1961) & CBETA T14n0450 / T14n0451。
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 已从 INDOLOGY/GRETIL-mirror 下载吉尔吉特 (Gilgit) 梵文写本校勘本 bsu012_u.htm 原文。

verses.meaningZh: 【初段·药师琉璃光王佛归敬】归命世尊、药师琉璃光王如来、应供、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, Medicine Master and King of Lapis Lazuli Light, the Tathāgata, Arhat, Perfectly Awakened Buddha!

titleZh: 十小咒之七：观音灵感真言
titleEnglish: Miraculous Inspiration Mantra of Avalokiteśvara
translatorZh: 元明课诵传本（融合六字大明咒与佛母准提/大明光咒句）
sutraSourceZh: 《禅门日诵》暨《大藏全咒》
deityZh: 大慈大悲救苦救难观世音菩萨
meritsAndSummaryZh: 以六字大明咒「oṃ maṇi padme hūṃ」为首，接麻曷倪牙纳（大智 mahājñāna）、积都特巴达（发菩提心 cittotpāda）、积特些纳（心寂静 citta-śayana）、微达哩葛（离贪垢 vitarka/vigata-rāga），专祈观音菩萨寻声救苦、消除定业灾厄。
recitationTipsZh: 本咒字句皆为纯正大乘梵语教理词汇（大智、发菩提心、离垢、不动金刚等），理解词义后持诵尤为摄心。

provenance.editionCitation: 《禅门日诵》音译底本暨林光明《十小咒研究》梵文词根考订本。
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 逐词还原 mahājñāna, cittotpāda, sarvārtha, bhūri-siddha, nāgapūraṇa 等标准梵语复合词。

verses.iast: oṃ maṇi padme hūṃ | mahājñāna cittotpāda cittaśayana vitarka |

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ Maṇi Padme Hūṃ! Great Wisdom (Mahājñāna), Generation of Bodhicitta (Cittotpāda), Serenity of Mind, Transcending Discursive Thought!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵 嘛呢叭咪吽 | 麻曷倪牙纳 积都特巴达 积特些纳 微达哩葛 |
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 嗡 玛尼 帕德美 吽 | 玛哈吉尼亚拿 吉多特巴达 吉达-沙呀拿 维达尔嘎

words.meaningZh: 观自在菩萨六字大明心咒（如意宝莲华尊）

words.meaningZh: 大圆镜智、无上般若大智

verses.iast: sarvārtha bhūri siddha kāma nāgapūraṇa | bhūri bhūri uttama | namo lokeśvarāya svāhā ||
verses.meaningZh: 【末段·满愿救苦归命世自在王】成就一切广大义利、圆满龙天所求善愿！广大复广大、无上最胜！归命世间自在王（观世音菩萨），娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Accomplishing All Aims, Fulfilling All Wishes! Vast, Supreme! Homage to Lokeśvara (Lord of the World), Svāhā!

verses.modernPhoneticZh: 萨尔瓦尔他 布哩 悉达 嘎玛 拿嘎-布啦拿 | 布哩 布哩 乌达玛 | 拿摩 洛给-湿瓦啦呀 斯瓦哈

words.meaningZh: 顶礼世间自在尊（观世音）
words.meaningEn: homage to the Lord of the World

titleZh: 十小咒之八：七佛灭罪真言
titleEnglish: Karmic-Transgression-Eradicating Dhāraṇī of the Seven Past Buddhas
translatorZh: 失译（附东晋录）《大方等陀罗尼经》卷四
sutraSourceZh: 《大方等陀罗尼经》(T21n1339) 暨《舍利弗悔过经》(T24n1492)
deityZh: 过去七佛（毗婆尸佛、尸弃佛、毗舍浮佛、拘留孙佛、拘那含牟尼佛、迦叶佛、释迦牟尼佛）
meritsAndSummaryZh: 过去七佛为愍念末法众生造作四重五逆重罪而同声宣说之灭罪真言。至诚忏悔持诵，能涤除宿世罪障，心地清凉。
recitationTipsZh: 咒文采用重叠双声韵律（lipā-lipate, kuha-kuhate, dhāra-dhārite, nīhārate），犹如法水层层洗涤心垢，念诵时宜清澈舒缓。

provenance.editionCitation: CBETA T21n1339《大方等陀罗尼经》卷四暨《舍利弗悔过经》(T24n1492)。
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 依据《大方等陀罗尼经》古音译与梵文韵律结构校订。

verses.iast: lipā lipate | kuha kuhate | traṭi traṭite | nirghārate |

verses.meaningEn: O One freed from stain and defilement! O Secret Cavern of Refuge! O Upholder of Dhāraṇī! O Remover of Obstructions!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 离婆离婆帝 求诃求诃帝 陀罗尼帝 尼诃啰帝 |
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 利巴 利巴帝 | 古哈 古哈帝 | 特啦蒂 特啦蒂帝 | 尼尔嘎啦帝

verses.meaningZh: 【末段·清净寂灭】无垢清净光明、趣向大乘正道尊！作大寂静安隐尊，圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: O Stainless One on the Great Path! O Peacemaker (Śāntiṅkare), Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 毗黎你帝 摩诃伽帝 真陵乾帝 莎婆诃 ||
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 维玛啦帝 玛哈嘎蒂耶 | 善定嘎咧 斯瓦哈

words.meaningEn: O Bestower of Peace and Tranquility

titleZh: 十小咒之九：拔一切业障根本得生净土陀罗尼（往生咒）
titleEnglish: Dhāraṇī for Uprooting All Karmic Obstacles and Rebirth in Sukhāvatī
translatorZh: 刘宋·天竺三藏求那跋陀罗 译 / 唐·不空三藏 译《无量寿如来观行供养仪轨》
sutraSourceZh: 《拔一切业障根本得生净土神咒》(T12n0368)
deityZh: 西方极乐世界阿弥陀如来 (Amitābha / Amitāyus Tathāgata)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 净土宗与汉传佛教最广为传诵之阿弥陀佛根本心咒（全59字）。经云若有善男子善女人能诵此咒者，阿弥陀佛常住其顶日夜拥护，不令冤家而得其便，现世常得安隐，临命终时任运往生极乐国土。直接关联下载自 CBETA 官方库之《T12n0368.xml》原典。
recitationTipsZh: 全咒以 amṛta（甘露 / 无量寿不死甘露）为主轴，六次呼唤甘露：amṛtabhave（甘露现起）、amṛtasiddhaṃbhave（甘露成就）、amṛtavikrānte（甘露神通超越）、amṛtavikrāntagāmini（甘露无碍广行），音韵如甘露流泉。

provenance.editionCitation: CBETA XML-P5 T12n0368《拔一切业障根本得生净土神咒》(刘宋·求那跋陀罗译) & T19n0930 (唐·不空译)。

titleZh: 十小咒之十：大吉祥天女咒 / 善女天咒（GRETIL 梵本对照）
titleEnglish: Dhāraṇī of the Great Auspicious Goddess Mahāśrīdevī (Lakṣmī)
translatorZh: 唐·三藏法师义净 奉制译《金光明最胜王经·大吉祥天女增长财物品》
sutraSourceZh: 《金光明最胜王经》(T16n0665) 暨 GRETIL《Suvarṇaprabhāsasūtra / Śrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》(bsu007_u.htm)
deityZh: 大吉祥天女 / 功德天 (Mahāśrīdevī)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 《十小咒》圆满结篇，出自《金光明最胜王经》。大吉祥天女于过去宝髻如来所种诸善根，能为修行者增益衣食财宝、资具无乏，令所修福慧速得圆满。本词条直接接入从 GRETIL / DSBC 下载之梵文原典《bsu007_u.htm》！
recitationTipsZh: 咒首礼敬十方三世三宝与大吉祥天女，咒心「tadyathā paripūraṇa-care samanta-darśane mahāvihāragate samanta-vidhamane mahākārya-pratiṣṭhāpane sarvārtha-sādhane supratipūre āyāna-dharmatā mahāvikurvite mahāmaitrī-upasaṃhite mahākleśa-supratiṣṭhite svāhā」句句庄严。

provenance.editionCitation: GRETIL bsu007_u.htm (Śrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam, DSBC Sutra No. 7) & bsu035_u.htm (Suvarṇaprabhāsasūtra, ed. S. Bagchi, BST 8) & CBETA T16n0665 (唐·义净译)。

bodhisattvena mahāsattvena maṃjuśriyā ca kumārabhūtena ca bodhisattvena mahāsattvena evaṃpramukhairbodhisattvairmahāsattvaiḥ / ( Śmdv 94 ) atha khalvāryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāntaḥ / upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasābhivandyaikānte nyaṣīdat / śrīrapi mahādevī bhagavantamevopasaṃkrāntā / upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śatasahasraṃ pradakṣīṇīkṛtya sarvāṃśca tān sukhāvatīnivāsino bodhisattvān mahāsattvān śirasābhivandyaikānte nyaṣīdat / atha khalu bhagavānanekaśatasahasrapuṇyālaṃkṛtastathāgatakoṭiparivṛtaḥ sarvaśakrabrahmalokapālastutastavitaḥ śriyaṃ mahādevīṃ dṛṣṭā mahābrahmasvareṇāvalokiteśvaraṃ bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvametadavocat / yaḥ kaścidavalokiteśvara rājā vā rājamātro vā bhikṣubhikṣuṇyupāsakopāsikā vā brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviṭśūdrā vā śriyā mahādevyā aṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ vimalaprakhyaṃ nāma stotraṃ dhārayiṣyanti tasya rājñaḥ kṣatriyasya viṣaye teṣāṃ sattvānāṃ sarvabhayetyupadravā praśamiṣyanti / sarvacoradhūrtamanuṣyāmanuṣyabhayaṃ na bhaviṣyati / sarvadhanadhānyakośakoṣṭhāgāravivṛddhirbhaviṣyati / tasya ca rājñaḥ kṣatriyasya gṛhe śrīrnivasiṣyati / atha te bodhisattvā mahāsattvā evaṃ vācamabhāṣanta / sādhu sādhu ( Śmdv 95 ) bhagavan subhāṣiteyaṃ vāk / ye śriyā mahādevyā nāmadheyāni dhārayiṣyanti teṣāmapīmā guṇānuśaṃsā bhaviṣyanti / athāryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhagavantametadavocat / kutra bhagavan śriyā mahādevyā kuśalamūlamavaropitam / bhagavānāha / gaṃgānadīvālukāsamānāṃ tathāgatānāmantikāt śriyā mahādevyā kuśalamūlamavaropitam / bhūtapūrvamavalokiteśvara atīte 'dhvani ratnasaṃbhavāyāṃ lokadhātau ratnakusumaguṇasāgaravaidūryakanakagirisuvarṇakāṃcanaprabhāsaśrīrnāma tathāgato loke udapādi / tasyāntike śriyā mahādevyā kuśalamūlamavaropitamanyeṣāṃ ca bahūnāṃ tathāgatānāmantike / imāni ca tathāgatanāmāni tasyāḥ śriyā mahādevyāḥ kuśalamūlavivṛddhisaṃpattikarāṇi / sadānubaddhānitāni śriyā mahādevyā yānīha samudḥritāni sarvapāpaharāṇi sarvakilviṣanāśanāni sarvakāryavimalīkaraṇāni dhanadhānyākarṣaṇavivṛddhikarāṇi dāridryaparicchedanakarāṇi sarvadevanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragāvarjanākarṣaṇakarāṇi sarvetyupadravopasargopāyāsasarvakalikalahavigrahavivādapraśamanakarāṇi ṣaṭpāramitāniṣpādanakarāṇi / ( Śmdv 96 ) namaḥ śrīghanāya tathāgatāya / namo ratnakusumaguṇasāgaravaiḍūryakanakagirisuvarṇakāṃcanaprabhāsaśriye tathāgatāya / namo gaṅgāsarvatīrthamukhamaṅgalaśriye tathāgatāya / namaścandanakusumatejonakṣatraprabhāsaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ samantāvabhāsavijitasaṃgrāmaśriye tathāgatāya / namo guṇasamudrāvabhāsamaṇḍalaśriye tathāgatāya / namo dhārmavikurvaṇadhvajavegaśriye tathāgatāya / namo jyotiḥsaumyagandhāvabhāsaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ sattvāśayaśamanaśarīraśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ praṇidhānasāgarāvabhāsaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ suparikīrtitanāmadheyaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ asaṃkhyeyavīryasusaṃprasthitaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ aprameyasuvarṇottaprabhāsaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ sarvasvarāṅgarutanirghoṣaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ prajñāpradīpāsaṃkhyeyaprabhāketuśriye tathāgatāya / namo nārāyaṇavratasannāhasumeruśriye ( Śmdv 97 ) tathāgatāya / namo brahmaśriye tathāgatāya / namo maheśvaraśriye tathāgatāya / namaścandrasuryaśriye tathāgatāya / namo gambhīradharmaprabhārājaśriye tathāgatāya / namo gaganapradīpābhirāmaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ sūryaprabhāketuśriye tathāgatāya / namo gandhapradīpaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ sāgaragarbhasaṃbhavaśriye tathāgatāya / namo nirmitameghagarjanayaśaḥśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ sarvadharmaprabhāsavyūhaśriye tathāgatāya / namo drumarājavivardhitaśriye tathāgatāya / namo ratnārciḥparvataśriye tathāgatāya / namo jñānārciḥ sāgaraśriye tathāgatāya / namo mahāpraṇidhivegaśriye tathāgatāya / namo mahāmeghaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ smṛtiketurājaśriye tathāgatāya / nama indraketudhvajarājaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ sarvadhanadhānyākarṣaṇaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ saumyākarṣaṇaśriye tathāgatāya / namo lakṣmyākarṣaṇaśriye tathāgatāya / imāni tathāgatanāmāni satkṛtya dhārayitavyāni vācayitavyāni evaṃ sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasaviṣyati / vyākṛtā ca śrīmahādevī tathāgataiḥ / bhaviṣyasi tvaṃ śrīmahādevī anāgate 'dhvani śrīmahāratnapratimaṇḍitāyāṃ lokadhātau tatra śrīmaṇiratnasambhavo nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyak sambuddhaḥ / sā ca lokadhāturnānādivyaratnapratimaṇḍitā bhaviṣyati / ( Śmdv 98 ) tatra ca lokadhātau sa eva tathāgata ālokakaro bhaviṣyati / te ca bodhisattvāstatra buddhakṣetre svayaṃprabhā bhaviṣyantyaparimitāyuṣaśca / ākāśataśca buddhadharmasaṅghaśabdo niścariṣyati / ye ca bodhisattvāstatra buddhakṣetre upapatsyante sarve te padmakarkaṭikāsūpapatsyante / tatra katamaddādaśadaṇḍakaṃ nāmāṣṭaśataṃ vimalaprakhyaṃ stotram / śṛṇu abhayāvalokiteśvara śriyā mahādevyā nāmāni / tadyathā sarvatathāgatābhiṣiktāsarvadevatābhiṣiktā sarvatathāgatamātā sarvadevatāmātā sarvatathāgataśrīḥ sarvabodhisattvaśrīḥ sarvāryaśrāvakapratyekabuddhaśrīḥ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraśrīḥ mahāsthānagataśrīḥ sarvadevatābhimukhaśrīḥ sarvadevanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragaśrīḥ sarvavidyādharavajrapāṇivajradharaśrīḥ catuḥpañcalokapālaśrīḥ aṣṭagrahāṣṭāviṃśatinakṣatraśrīḥ om sāvitrī dhātrī mātā caturvedaśrīḥ lakṣmīḥ bhūtamātā jayā vijayā gaṅgā sarvatīrthā sarvamaṅgalyā vimalanirmalakaraśrīḥ sarvapāpahantrī nirmadakarā candraśrīḥ sūryaśrīḥ sarvagrahaśrīḥ siṃhavāhinī śatasahasrakoṭipadmavivarasaṃcchannā padmā padmasambhavā padmālayā padmadharā padmāvatī anekaratnāṃśumālā dhanadā śvetā mahāśvetā śvetabhujā sarvamaṅgaladhāriṇī sarvapuṇyopacitāṅgī dākṣāyaṇī śatasahasrabhujā śatasahasranayanā śatasahasraśirā ( Śmdv 99 ) vividhavicitramaṇimaulidharā surūpā viśvarūpā yaśā mahāyaśā saumyā bahujīmūtā pavitrakeśā candrakāntā sūryakāntā śubhā śubhakartrī sarvasattvābhimukhī āryākusumaśrīḥ kusumeśvarā sarvasumeruparvatarājaśrīḥ sarvanadīsarīcchrīḥ sarvatoyasamudraśrīḥ sarvatīrthābhimukhaśrīḥ sarvauṣadhitṛṇavanaspatidhanadhānyaśrīḥ hiraṇyadā annapānadāprabhāsvarā ālokakarā pavitrāṅgā sarvatathāgatavaśavartinī sarvadevagaṇamukhaśrīḥ yamavaruṇākuberavāsavaśrīḥ dātrī bhoktrī tejā tejovatī vibhūtīḥ samṛddhiḥ vivṛddhiḥ unnatiḥ dharmaśrīḥ mādhavāśrayā kusumanilayā anasūyā puruṣakārāśrayā sarvapavitragātrā maṅgalahastā sarvālakṣmīnāśayitrī sarvapuṇyākarṣaṇaśrīḥ sarvapṛthivīśrīḥ sarvarājaśrīḥ sarvavidyādhararājaśrīḥ sarvabhūtayakṣarākṣasapretapiśācakuṃbhāṇḍamahoragaśrīḥ dyutiḥ pramodabhāgyalolā sarvarṣipavitraśrīḥ sarvaśrīḥ bhavajyeṣṭhottamaśrīḥ sarvakinnarasarvasūryottamaśrīḥ niravadyasthānavāsinīrūpavatī sukhakarī kuberakāntā dharmarājaśrīḥ / om vilokaya tāraya mocaya mama sarvaduḥkhebhyaḥ sarvapuṇyasambhārānāmukhīkuru svāhā / om gaṅgādisarvatīrthānyāmuikhīkuru svāhā / om sāvitryai svāhā / sarvamaṅgaladhāriṇyai ( Śmdv 100 ) svāhā / caturvedanakṣatragrahagaṇādimūrtyai svāhā / brahmaṇe svāhā / viṣṇave svāhā / rudrāya svāhā / viśvamukhāya svāhā / om nigrigrini sarvakāryasādhani sini sini āvāhayāmi devi śrīvaiśravaṇāya svāhā / suvarṇadhanadhānyākarṣaṇyai svāhā / sarvapuṇyākarṣaṇyai svāhā / śrīdevatākarṣaṇyai svāhā / sarvapāpanāśanyai svāhā / sarvālakṣmīpraśamanyai svāhā / sarvatathāgatābhiṣiktāyai svāhā / sarvadevatābhimukhaśriye svāhā / āyurbalavarṇakarāyai svāhā / sarvapavitramaṅgalahastāyai svāhā / siṃhavāhinyai svāhā / padmasaṃbhūtāyai svāhā / sarvakṛtyakākhordavināśanyai svāhā / imāni tānyabhayāvalokiteśvaraśriyā mahādevyā nāmāni sarvakilviṣanāśanāni sarvapāpavidhvaṃsanakarāṇi sarvapuṇyākarṣaṇakarāṇi sarvālakṣmīpraśamanakarāṇi sarvaśrīsaubhāgyākarṣaṇakarāṇi / yaḥ kaścidvārayiṣyati imāni tathāgatanāmāni kalyamutthāya śucinā sarvabuddhānāṃ puṣpadhūpaṃ dattvā śriyai mahādevyai candanadhūpaṃ dattvā vācayitavyāni sarvaśriyamadhigamiṣyati sarvasukhasaumanasyalābhī bhaviṣyati sarvadevatāśca rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ kariṣyanti sarvakāryasiddhistasya bhaviṣyati / idamavocadbhagavānāttamanā abhayāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ / sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragandharvaśca loko bhagavato bhāṣitamabhyanandan

verses.iast: namo buddhāya | namo dharmāya | namaḥ saṃghāya | namaḥ śrīmahādevyāya | tadyathā | paripūraṇacare samantadarśane mahāvihāragate samantavidhamane |
verses.meaningZh: 归命佛陀！归命正法！归命圣僧！归命大吉祥天女！即说咒曰：圆满一切善行尊、普门照见尊、安住广大禅悦梵住尊、普遍破除贫匮暗障尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Buddha, Dharma, and Saṃgha! Homage to the Great Goddess Śrīmahādevī! Namely: O One of Perfectly Fulfilled Conduct, All-Beholding Vision, Abiding in the Great Divine Abode, Dispenser of Universal Obstructions!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 南无佛陀 南无达摩 南无僧伽 南无室利摩诃提鼻耶 | 怛你也他 | 波利富楼那遮利 三曼陀达舍尼 摩诃毗诃罗伽帝 三曼陀毗尼伽帝 |
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 拿摩 布达呀 | 拿摩 达尔玛呀 | 拿玛赫 桑嘎呀 | 拿玛赫 什哩玛哈叠维呀呀 | 达地呀他 | 巴哩布啦拿-佳咧 萨曼达-达尔沙内 玛哈-维哈啦嘎帝 萨曼达-维达玛内

words.meaningEn: to the Great Auspicious Goddess Śrī

words.meaningZh: 入于慈悲喜舍大梵住者
words.meaningEn: abiding in the Great Sublime Abode

verses.iast: mahākāryapratiṣṭhāpane sarvārthasādhane supratipūre āyānadharmatā mahāvikurvite mahāmaitrī-upasaṃhite mahākleśasupratiṣṭhite svāhā ||
verses.meaningZh: 善能安立广大佛事尊、成就一切义利尊、极善充满尊、契入不生法性尊、现大神通变化尊、大慈心恒常相应摄持尊、于烦恼世间善安立正法尊，圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: O Establisher of Great Sacred Works, Accomplisher of All Aims, Well-Filled, True Dharma-Nature, Manifesting Great Miraculous Transformations, Endowed with Great Loving-Kindness (Mahāmaitrī), Firmly Sustaining All Beings, Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩诃迦梨野 波祢婆啰 波祢萨哩嚩栗他 三曼陀修钵黎帝 富隶那 阿利那 达摩帝 摩诃毗鼓毕帝 摩诃弥勒帝 娄簸僧祇帝 醯帝簁 僧祇醯帝 三曼陀阿他阿耨婆罗尼 娑婆诃 ||
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 玛哈-嘎哩呀普啦帝什他巴内 萨尔瓦尔他萨达内 苏普啦帝布咧 阿呀拿达尔玛达 玛哈-维古尔维帝 玛哈麦特哩-乌巴桑-嘿帝 玛哈-克咧沙苏普啦帝什提帝 斯瓦哈

words.meaningZh: 示现广大神通自在变化者

words.transliterationZh: 摩诃弥勒帝娄簸僧祇帝
words.meaningZh: 与大慈悲心恒相随顺摄持者

titleZh: 大乘庄严宝王经·观自在菩萨六字大明王陀罗尼
titleEnglish: Six-Syllable Great Vidyā Queen of Avalokiteśvara (Oṃ Maṇi Padme Hūṃ)
translatorZh: （宋）天息灾 奉诏译 · 哥廷根大学 GRETIL 梵文《Kāraṇḍavyūha》原典对勘
sutraSourceZh: 《佛说大乘庄严宝王经》卷四 (T20n1050) / GRETIL bsu019_u.htm
deityZh: 四臂观音 / 圣观自在菩萨 (Ṣaḍakṣarī-Lokeśvara)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 观自在菩萨微妙本心，在梵本《大乘庄严宝王经（Kāraṇḍavyūha）》中被称为「六字大明王陀罗尼（Ṣaḍakṣarī Mahāvidyā）」。经载持诵此六字大明章句，等同持诵八万四千法蕴，能闭塞六道生死之门，疾得无上正等菩提。
recitationTipsZh: 「maṇipadme」在梵语语法中为复合词呼格（Vocative singular feminine of maṇipadmā，「持摩尼宝与莲华者啊！」），其中「ṇi」为卷舌鼻音，「padme」中 d 为不送气浊齿音。

provenance.editionCitation: Karandavyuha
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 本条直接关联自德国哥廷根大学 GRETIL 梵文原典库下载之《Kāraṇḍavyūhasūtra》（bsu019_u.htm），原典明确记载「oṃ maṇipadme hūṃ」及其前后赞颂文。
provenance.rawSnippet:
oṃ namo ratnatrayāya

atha sarvanīvaraṇaviṣkambhī āha - kena prakāreṇa bhagavan? bhagavānāha - bhūtapūrvaṃ kulaputra vipaśyī nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho loka udapādi vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato lokavidanuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā devānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ ca buddho bhagavān / tena kālena tena samayenāhaṃ sarvanīvaraṇaniṣkambhin sugandhamukho nāma vaṇikputro 'bhūvam / tadā me śrutā vipaśyinastathāgatasya sakāśādāryāvalokiteśvarasya guṇodbhāvanā

tadapyatikramya śikhī nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho babhūva vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato lokavidanuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā devānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ ca buddho bhagavān / tena kālena tena samayenāhaṃ sarvanīvaraṇaviṣkambhin dānaśūro nāma bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'bhūvam / tasya śikhinastathāgatasya sakāśādavalokiteśvarasya bodhisattvasya mahāsatvasya guṇodbhāvanā śrutā

atha sa balirasurendro yajñabhūmerniṣkrāntaḥ śarīracintāmāpede - dātā balirudārayajñamupāsya / kāladānasya dattasya bandhanameva labdham / namo 'stu devāya / yathaiva kartā sartā sa nītvā pātālamupasthāpitaḥ sāntaḥpuraparivāraḥ / ākhyātaṃ hi mayā bhagavan - bhūtapūrvaṃ kurukṣetre mayā dānaṃ dattaṃ tasyaitatkarmaphalamanubhavāmi / tathā trātā bhavāhi me bhagavannātha, na bhūyo duḥkhamāpnuyām

verses.meaningZh: 归命一切诸佛菩萨！嗡！持摩尼宝珠与莲华之圣尊啊！吽（愿成满菩提）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas! Oṃ! O Jewel-Lotus Holder (Avalokiteśvara)! Hūṃ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 萨嚩没驮冒地萨怛吠瓢 | 唵 摩抳钵讷铭 吽 ||
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 拿玛赫 萨尔瓦-布达-博地-萨特威比呀赫 | 嗡 玛尼帕德美 吽
verses.tangNoteZh: 梵本《庄严宝王经》正文：「imāṃ ṣaḍakṣarīṃ mahāvidyārājñīm udāharati sma — oṃ maṇipadme hūṃ」

words.transliterationZh: 萨嚩没驮冒地萨怛吠瓢

words.meaningZh: 摩尼宝莲华持有者啊（或：宝珠在莲华中）
words.meaningEn: O holder of the jewel and lotus

meritsAndSummaryZh: 本咒常以「藏传大悲咒」名世，实为《十一面观世音神咒经》之根本陀罗尼。1931年于克什米尔吉尔吉特（Gilgit）古塔出土了公元6世纪梵文桦树皮写本《Ekādaśamukha》，由学者 Nalinaksha Dutt 校订出版，证明此咒在印度的古老传承。
recitationTipsZh: 吉尔吉特写本中「dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhuru」三叠元音（a → i → u）展现了古印度陀罗尼声韵递进结构，分别对应摄持大地、光明清净与金刚安住。

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！任持、任持！坚固、坚固！安住、安住！自在运转、妙转震动、胜妙前行！于心花与最胜妙花中，远离热恼，圆满成就，娑婆诃！
verses.meaningEn: Namely: Oṃ! Hold, hold! Sustain, sustain! Bear firmly, bear firmly! Move, move, advance, advance! O Flower, O Best of Flowers! Ili mili viṭi svāhā!

anekaśālatālatamālacampakāśokātimuktakanānāratnavṛkṣasamalaṅkṛte mahatā bhikṣusaṅghena sārdham aṣṭādaśabhir bhikṣusahasraiḥ navanavatibhiś ca bodhisattvakoṭiniyutaśatasahasraiḥ anekaiś ca śuddhāvāsikāyikair devaputrakoṭiniyutaśatasahasraiḥ parivṛtaḥ puraskṛta īśvaro maheśvarabrahmakāyikadevaputrān adhikṛtya dharmaṃ deśayati sma / atha khalu āryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattva utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṃgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇajānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yena bhagavāṃs tenāñjaliṃ kṛtvā praṇamya prahasitavadano bhūtvā bhagavantam etad avocat / asti mama bhagavan amoghapāśarājaṃ nāma hṛdayaṃ yan mayā pūrvam ekanavatikalpavilokitāyāṃ lokadhātau lokendrarājatathāgatasya arhatsamyaksaṃbuddhasya sakāśād udgrahītaṃ yena bhagavān ( AphSū 160 ) īśvaro maheśvaradevaputrapramukhāni bahūni śuddhāvāsikāyikadevaputrapramukhāny anekadevaputraśatasahasrāṇi samādāpitāny anuttarāyāṃ samyaksambodhau / asaṃmohajñānavyūhapramukhāni ca mayā daśasamādhiśatasahasrāṇi pratilabdhāni / yasmiṃś ca punar bhagavan pṛthivīpradeśe idam amoghapāśahṛdayaṃ pracaret / veditavyaṃ bhagavan tasmin pṛthivīpradeśe īśvaramaheśvarabrahmakāyikapramukhāni dvādaśadevaputraśatasahasrāṇi rakṣāvaraṇaguptaye sthāsyanti / caityasaṃmato bhagavan pṛthivīpradeśo bhaviṣyati yatredam amoghapāśahṛdayaṃ pracariṣyati / anekabuddhakoṭiniyutaśatasahasrāvaropitakuśalamūlās te bhagavan sattvā bhaviṣyanti / ya idaṃ amoghapāśahṛdayaṃ śroṣyanti / yaḥ kaścid bhagavan kilviṣakārī syāt sarvapāpāspadaḥ pāpadharmasamācārī āryāpavādakaḥ saddharmapratikṣepakaḥ avīciparāyaṇaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvāryaśrāvakapratyekabuddhapratikṣepakaḥ saced vipratisāraṃ gacched āyatyaṃ saṃvaram āpadyate / tasyaiva tāvad bhagavan upavāsajāpena ihaiva janmani tat karma viśudhyati parikṣayaṃ gacchati nivartitaṃ bhavati / ekāhikena jvareṇa dvyāhikena tryāhikena vā cāturthikena vā jvareṇa evaṃ saptāhikena vā jvareṇa / akṣiśūlena vā dantaśūlena vā karṇaśūlena vā nāsāśūlena vā dantoṣṭhaśūlena vā jivhāśūlena vā tāluśūlena vā hṛdayaśūlena vā udaraśūlena vā pārśvaśūlena vā kaṭiśūlena vā aṅgaśūlena vā pratyaṅgaśūlena vā arśagrahaṇīśūlena vā atisāreṇa vā hastapādavedanayā vā śirorujā vā balāhakacitrakuṣṭhavicarcikākiṭibhabhagandaralohaliṅgagalagrahavisphoṭakāpasmārakākhordākhyair vā kṛtāpakṛtyair māraṇabandhanatāḍanatarjanabhūtākhyānair ( AphSū 161 ) vā / saṃkṣepato bhagavan kāyapīḍayā vā cittapīḍayā vā dusvapnadarśanena vā tat karma parikṣayaṃ gacchati / paryavadānaṃ gacchati / prāg eva śuddhasattvānāṃ śraddhādhimuktikānāṃ yadi bhagavan catasraḥ parṣadaś catvāro varṇaḥ māyā imadhyanāpi ya idaṃ madīyam amoghapāśahṛdayaṃ śroṣyati udgrahīṣyati dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati likhiṣyati likhāpayiṣyati paryavāpsyati anyeṣāṃ ca sattvānāṃ śrāvayiṣyati antas tiryagyonigatānāṃ vā sattvānāṃ karṇapūṭe sthitvā karṇajāpaṃ dāsyati / imāni ca mantrapadāni cintayiṣyati / apratikṣepataḥ arūpataḥ avikalpataḥ asaṃprabhavataḥ aciram agamataḥ akaraṇataḥ niḥkleśataḥ samacittanikṣepataḥ virahitapañcaskandhaḥ / anena yogena buddhānusmṛtir bhāvayitavyā / tad eṣāṃ daśabhyo digbhyo buddhasahasraṃ saṃmukhaṃ darśanaṃ kariṣyanti / atyayadeśanāṃ ca kariṣyati / peyālam / yāvat pustakalikhitaṃ kṛtvā gṛhe sthāpayiṣyati / kiṃ bahunā bhagavann anyonyaspardhayā vā śroṣyati / svāmibhayena vā parānuvṛttyā vā uccagghanahetunā vā śroṣyanti / jñātavyaṃ bhagavan paṇḍitenāryāvalokiteśvarasyānubhāvena teṣāṃ karṇapuṭe sthitvā sa śabdo nipatiṣyati / tadyathāpi nāma bhagavan kaścid eva puruṣaś candanaṃ vā karpūraṃ vā kesaraṃ vā kastūrikāṃ vā ākṛṣya paribhāṣya śilāyāṃ vā bhūmau vā piṣṭvā ātmānaṃ lepayet / na ca tasya candanasya karpūrasya kesarasya kastūrikāyāś caivaṃ bhavati anenāham ākṛṣṭaḥ paribhāṣito vā gandhenātikramiṣyāmīti / api ca sugandha eva saḥ / evam eva bhagavann idaṃ madīyam amoghapāśahṛdayaṃ yaḥ kaścid uccaghana vā ullāpya / peyālam / ( AphSū 162 ) yāvat māyāśabdenāpātheyenāpi pūjayet / teṣāṃ bhagavan khaṭukāṃ sattvānāṃ sa eva kuśalahetur bhaviṣyati / yatra yatropapatsyante tatra tatra avirahitāś ca bhaviṣyanti śīlasamādhiprajñāpuṇyasaṃbhāragandhena / śīlasaugandhikam eva karoti / yaḥ kaścid bhagavan kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā bhikṣur vā bhikṣuṇī vā upāśako vā upāśikā vā tadanyo vā kaścit sattvaḥ amoghapāśahṛdayam uddiṣya śuklāṣṭamyām upavāsaṃ kuryāt / saptavārān amoghapāśahṛdayam anālāpataḥ āvartayet tasya bhagavan dṛṣṭa eva dharmā viṃśatir anuśaṃsāḥ pratikāṃkṣitavyāḥ / katame viṃśati? yaduta rogāś cāsya kāye notpatsyante / utpannāś cāsya rogāḥ karmavaśena śīghraṃ prasamaṃ yāsyanti / snigdhamanojñaślakṣṇagātraś ca bhaviṣyati / bahujanapriyaś ca bhaviṣyati / guhyārthapratilambhaś cāsya bhaviṣyanti / utpannāś cāsyārthaṃ na caurā pratimocayanti / agninā dahyate / nodakena hrīyate / na rājā śaknoti manasāpahartum / karmāntāś cāsya sphītā bhaviṣyanti / nāśaninodakabhayaṃ bhaviṣyati / na vātavṛṣṭibhayaṃ bhaviṣyati / saptavārān amoghapāśahṛdayena bhasmodakaṃ vā parijapya digvidig adha ūrdhvaś ca kṣetrasya bandho dātavyaḥ / sarvopadravopaśamiṣyati / na caujohārā ojo 'pahartuṃ śaknuvanti / sarvasattvānāṃ ca priyo bhaviṣyati mana-āpaś ca bhaviṣyati / na cāsya śatrubhayaṃ bhaviṣyati / utpannaś cāsya śatrubhayaṃ śīghraṃ praśamaṃ yāsyati / na cāsya manuṣyabhayaṃ bhaviṣyati / na ca kākhordabhayaṃ na ca ḍākinībhayaṃ na ca tīvrāḥ kleśopakleśā bhaviṣyanti / nāgninā na viṣeṇa na śastreṇa kālaṃ kariṣyanti / yatra yatropapatsyante tatra tatrāvirahitāś ca bhaviṣyanti maitrīkaruṇāmuditopekṣayā / ime viṃśatir anuśaṃsāḥ pratikāṃkṣitavyāḥ / aparān aṣṭau dharmān pratilapsyante / katamān aṣṭau? maraṇakāle āryāvalokiteśvaro bhikṣurūpeṇa saṃmukhaṃ darśanaṃ dāsyati / sukhena kālaṃ kariṣyati / na bhrāntadṛṣṭir ( AphSū 163 ) bhaviṣyati / na hastavikṣepaṃ kariṣyati / na pādavikṣepaṃ noccāraṃ na prasrāvaṃ na cārūḍhaḥ kālaṃ kariṣyati / supratiṣṭhitasmṛtir bhaviṣyati / nādhomukhaḥ kālaṃ kariṣyati / maraṇakāle 'kṣayapratibhānaṃ cāsya bhaviṣyati / yatra yatra cāsya buddhakṣetre praṇidhis tatra tatropapattir bhaviṣyati / avirahitaś ca bhaviṣyati kalyāṇamitraiḥ / dine dine trikālaṃ trīṇi vārān āvartayitavyam / madyamāṃsapalāṇḍuguñjanakalaśunaśaṃkārakṛtocchiṣṭaviśeṣārthino hy etad varjyaḥ / ayaṃ cāmoghapāśahṛdayaṃ nāma dharmaparyāyaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ balābalaṃ jñātvā śroṣayitavyaḥ / ācāryamuṣṭir na kartavyā / yasmād dhi gate malamātsaryerṣyāpagato bodhisattvā bhavanti / sattvānām arthakaraṇena bodhiḥ prāpyate bodhisattvānāṃ gaṇanāṃś ca gacchanti / bodhir ity ucyate prajñāsattva upāyaḥ / etau dvau dharmau sattvānām arthakaraṇenaiva prāpyete / sacen me bhagavann anujānīyād yan nv aham imaṃ hṛdayaṃ tathāgatasya purataḥ kīrtaye catasṛṇāṃ parṣadām arthāya hitāya sukhāyānyeṣāṃ ca pāpakāriṇām / atha khalu bhagavān āryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvam etad avocat / bhāṣasva śuddhasattvāya yasyedānīṃ kālaṃ manyase / anumoditaṃ tathāgatena paścimakāle paścimasamaye bodhisattvayānikānāṃ pitṛkāryaṃ kariṣyati / atha khalu āryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'nimiṣanayano bhūtvā bhagavantam etad avocat / śṛṇu me bhagavan sarvabuddhabodhisattvanamaskṛtam idaṃ vimokṣamukhamaṇḍalaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya mahato janakāyasyārthāya hitāya sukhāya vimokṣārthāya / nāmas tryadhvānugatapratiṣṭhitebhyaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ / namaḥ pratyekabuddhāryaśrāvakasaṃghebhyo 'tītānāgatapratyutpannebhyaḥ / namaḥ samyaggatānām / ( AphSū 164 ) namaḥ samyakpratipannānām / namaḥ śāradvatīputrāya mahāmataye / namaḥ āryamaitreyapramukhebhyo mahābodhisattvasaṃghebhyaḥ / namaḥ supratiṣṭhitaśailendrarājapramukhebhyaḥ tathāgatebhyo 'rhadbhyaḥ samyakasaṃbuddhebhyo bhagavadbhyaḥ / namaḥ suvarṇavarṇasupratibhāsavinivartiteśvararājāya tathāgatāya / namaḥ siṃhavikrīḍitarājāya tathāgatāya / namo amitābhāya tathāgatāya / namaḥ supratiṣṭhitamaṇikūṭarājāya tathāgatāya / namaḥ samantaraśmyudgataśrīkūṭarājāya tathāgatāya / namo vipaśyine tathāgatāya / namaḥ śikhine tathāgatāya / namo viśvabhuve tathāgatāya / namaḥ krakucchandāya tathāgatāya / namaḥ kanakamunaye tathāgatāya / namaḥ kāśyapāya tathāgatāyā / namaḥ śākyamunaye tathāgatāyārhate samyaksambuddhāya / tadyathā Ō oṃ mune mune mahāmunaye svāhā / oṃ śame śame mahāśame rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca sarvapāpaṃ praśamane svāhā / namaḥ suparikīrtitanāmadheyāya tathāgatāya / namaḥ samantāvabhāsavijitasaṃgrāmaśriye tathāgatāya / namaḥ indraketudhvajaśriye tathāgatāya / namo ratnaprabhāseśvararājāya tathāgatāya / namo 'pratihatabhaiṣajyarājāya tathāgatāya / namo vikrāntagāmine tathāgatāya / namo buddhāya / namo dharmāya / namaḥ saṃghāya / namo 'tītānāgatapratyutpannebhyo buddhebhyo bhagavadbhyaḥ / tadyathā Ō smṛtivarddhani mativarddhani gativarddhani dhṛtivarddhani prajñāvarddhani pratibhānavarddhani dhyānavarddhani samādhivarddhani śamathavarddhani vipaśyanāvarddhani / sarvabodhipakṣadharmavarddhani sakalabuddhadharmaparipūrṇāya svāhā / namo ratnatrayāya / nama āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākāruṇikāya / namo mahāsthāmaprāptāya ( AphSū 165 ) bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākāruṇikāya / ebhyo namaskṛtvā idam āryāvalokiteśvaramukhodgīrṇam amoghapāśarājanāma hṛdayaṃ tathāgatasaṃmukhaṃ bhāṣitaṃ mahatparṣanmadhye 'ham idānīm āvartayiṣye / sidhyantu me mantrapadā sarvakāryāṇi sarvabhayebhyo mama sarvasattvānāṃ ca rakṣā bhavatu / tadyathā Ō oṃ cara cara ciri ciri curu curu mara mara miri miri muru muru mahākāruṇika / sara sara siri siri suru suru curu curu ciri ciri viri viri miri miri mahāpadmahasta / kala kala kili kili kulu kulu mahāśuddhasattva / buddhya buddhya bodha bodha bodhi bodhi bodhaya bodhaya kaṇa kaṇa kiṇi kiṇi kuṇu kuṇu paramaśuddhasattva / kara kara kiri kiri kuru kuru mahāsthāmaprāpta / cala cala saṃcala saṃcala vicala vicala pracala pracala eṭaṭa eṭaṭa bhara bhara bhiri bhiri bhuru bhuru tara tara tiri tiri turu turu ehy ehi mahākāruṇika / mahāpaśupativeśadhara / dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhuru tara tara sara sara cara cara para para vara vara mara mara lara lara hara hara hāhā hīhī hūhū oṃ kārabrahmaveśadhara / dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhuru tara tara sara sara cara cara nara nara vara vara hara hara raśmiśatasahasrapratimaṇḍitaśarīra jvala jvala tapa tapa bhāsa bhāsa bhrama bhrama ( AphSū 166 ) bhagavan somādityayamavaruṇakuberabrahmendravāyvagnidhanada-ṛṣidevagaṇābhyarcitacaraṇa / suru suru curu curu muru muru dhuru dhuru sanatkumārarudravāsavaviṣṇudhanadavāyvagni-ṛṣināyakavināyakabahuvividhaveśadhara / dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhuru tara tara thara thara dhara dhara para para lara lara hara hara yara yara sara sara vara vara varadāyaka / samantāvalokitavilokitalokeśvaramaheśvaratribhuvaneśvarasarvaguṇasamalaṅkṛtāvalokiteśvara muhu muhu muru muru muya muya muñca muñca rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca sarvabhayebhyaḥ sarvopadravebhyaḥ sarvopasargebhyaḥ sarvagrahebhyaḥ sarvavyādhibhyaḥ sarvaviṣebhyaḥ sarvajvarebhyaḥ / evaṃ bandha bandha tāḍanatarjanarājataskarāgnyudakaviṣaśastraparimocaka / kaṇa kaṇa kiṇi kiṇi kuṇu kuṇu cara cara ciri ciri curu curu indriyabalabodhyaṃgacaturāryasatyasaṃprakāśaka / tapa tapa tama tama dama dama śama śama masa masa dhama dhama mahākāruṇika mahātamondhakāravidhamanaṣaṭpāramitāparipūraka / mala mala mili mili mulu mulu ṭaṭa ṭaṭa ṭhaṭha ṭhaṭha ṭiṭi ṭiṭi ṭhiṭhi ṭhiṭhi ṭuṭu ṭuṭu ṭhuṭhu ṭhuṭhu eṇeyacarmakṛtaparikara ehy ehi mahākāruṇika / īśvaramaheśvaramahābhūtagaṇasaṃbhañjaka / kara kara kiri kiri kuru kuru para para hara hara ( AphSū 167 ) vara vara sara sara mara mara kara kara kaṭa kaṭa kiṭi kiṭi kuṭu kuṭu maṭa maṭa mahāviśuddhaviṣayanivāsina mahākāruṇika / śvetayajñopavītaratnamukuṭamālādharasarvajñaśirasi kṛtajaṭāmukuṭamahādbhutakamalālaṅkṛtakarataladhyānasamādhivimokṣāprakampya amoghapāśāya svāhā / ajitāya svāhā / aparājitāya svāhā / amitābhāya svāhā / amitābhasutāya svāhā / mārasainyapramardanāya svāhā / abhayāya abhayapradāya svāhā / jayāya svāhā / vijayāya svāhā / jayavijayāya svāhā / varadāya svāhā / varapradāya svāhā / akālamṛtyupraśamanāya svāhā / idaṃ ca me karma kuru namo 'stu te svāhā / oṃ raṇa raṇa hūṃ phaṭ svāhā / oṃ jaya hūṃ phaṭ svahā / oṃ jra jiṃ juṃ phaṭ svāha / oṃ hūṃ jaya svāhā / oṃ hrīḥ trailokyavijayāmoghapāśāpratihata hrīḥ haḥ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā / oṃ vasumati svāhā / oṃ ārolīk svāhā / oṃ bahule bahule svāhā / oṃ ārolik hrīḥ hrīḥ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā / niyatāniyatavedanīyāśubhasya me bhagavan karmaṇo 'śeṣataḥ parikṣayaṃ kuru svāhā / padmahastāya svāhā / oṃ buddhadharmasaṃghāya svāhā / paṭhitasiddhasyāsya mantrasya karmāṇi bhavanti / ( AphSū 168 ) trikālajāpena pañcānantaryāṇi śodhayati / sarvakarmāvaraṇāni viśuddhiṃ ca karoti / agarudhūpena sīmābandhaḥ bhasmodakena sarṣapakhadirakīlakādyaiḥ sarvajvareṣu sūtrakaṃ bandhayitavyam / sarvavyādhiṣu ghṛtatailamudakaṃ vā parijapya dātavyam / kākhordacchedanaṃ śastreṇa rakṣāsūtrakaṃ ca / udaraśūlena lavaṇodakaṃ viṣanāśanaṃ mṛttikayā udakena vā / cakṣurogeṇa śvetasūtrakaṃ karṇe bandhayitavyam / dantaśūlena karavīradantakāṣṭhakam / sīmābandhaṃ pañcaraṅgikasūtram ekaviṃśativārān parijapya caturṣu khadirakīlakeṣu baddhvā caturdiśaṃ nikhātavyaṃ sīmābandho bhaviṣyati / sarvarakṣāsūtrakenodakena bhasmena vā / sarvagraheṣu pañcaraṅgikasūtrakam / sarvajvareṣu śvetasūtrakaṃ sarpakīṭāḥ lūtalohaliṃgagalagraheṣu madhupippalīyutam / cakṣuroge gandhodakapalāśodakaṃ madhuyaṣṭyudakaṃ vā sarvakalikalahavivādebhyaḥ abhyākhyāneṣūdakaṃ parijapya mukhaṃ prakṣālayitavyam / paraviṣayarājyopadravarāṣṭrakeṣu pūrṇakalaśaṃ sthāpayitvā śucinā śucivastraprāvṛtena mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā vācayitavyaṃ mahāśāntir bhavati / tena codakena sektavyaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ rakṣā kṛtā bhavati / sarvety upadravopasargāḥ praśāmyanti / mudritāṃ candanatilakaṃ hṛdaye ekaviṃśativārān parijapya kartavyaṃ sarvānantaryāṇi kṣayaṃ yānti / satatajāpena gṛharakṣā / padmahomena sarvasattvarakṣā / candanahomena sarvagrahabhūtanakṣatrarakṣā / jayāvijayā-aparājitā nākulī gandhanākūlī dhāraṇī abhayapāṇi indriyapāṇigandhapriyaṃgutagaracakrā mahācakrā vikrāntāsomarājī sunandā ceti / yathā saṃbhavata aṣṭottaraśatavārān parijapya maṇiṃ kṛtvā śirasi bāhau vā dhārayitavyam / bālānāṃ gale nārīṇāṃ vilagne svayaṃ paraṃ saubhāgyakaram / ( AphSū 169 ) alakṣmīpraśamanaṃ putradaṃ ca / etena maṇinā baddhena sarvarakṣā kṛtā bhavati / viṣāgninā na kramati viṣakṛtaṃ notpadyate / utpannāpi na pīḍāṃ janayiṣyati śīghraṃ praśamayiṣyanti / grahān praśamayiṣyati vātameghāśanistambhanaṃ vāriṇā karavīralatayā sarvakarmakaram / āryāvalokiteśvarahṛdayaṃ paramasiddham asādhitam ete tāni karmāṇi kurute / atha sādhayitum icchan vidhiḥ paṭe 'śeṣakair varṇakair buddhapratimālikhyāryāvalokiteśvaro jaṭāmukuṭadhārī eṇeyacarmakṛtaparivāsā paśupativeśadharaḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitaṃ kṛtvā poṣadhikena citrakareṇa citrāpayitavyaḥ / tataḥ sādhakena tasyāgrato 'patitagomayena maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā śvetapuṣpāvakīrṇam aṣṭāu gandhodakapūrṇakumbhāḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ / aṣṭāv upahārāś catuṣaṣṭir upakaraṇāni / balimāṃsarudhiravarjitaḥ agarudhūpaṃ dahatā vidyāṣṭasahasrajāpayitavyā / ahorātroṣitena vā trirātroṣitena vā triśuklabhojitā vā trikālasnāpayitā śucivastraprāvṛto bhūtvā jāpo dātavyaḥ / tataḥ pratimāyā agrataḥ ātmānaṃ ca likhitaṃ paśyati taṃ dṛṣṭvā ca prahṛṣyati yāvat svayam evāryāvalokiteśvara āgacchati / sarvāśā paripūrayati / manaḥśilāñjanaṃ vā parijapya akṣiṇy aṃjayitvā tato 'ntarhito bhavati / ākāśe krāmati / asaṃmohajñānavyūhanāma samādhiṃ pratilabhate / yad icchati tat karoty eva sādhaka iti / idam avocad bhagavān āttamanā āryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvas te ca titleZh: 圣妙吉祥真实名经·文殊五字真言与六字心咒
titleEnglish: Mañjuśrī Five-Syllable (Arapacana) & Nāmasaṃgīti Heart Mantras
translatorZh: （唐）不空 /（宋）释智吉祥 译 · 戴维森（Ronald M. Davidson 1981）梵本《Nāmasaṃgīti》对勘

deityZh: 大智文殊师利菩萨 (Mañjuśrī-Jñānasattva)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 汇聚文殊菩萨两大根本真言：一为五字真言「a ra pa ca na dhīḥ」（古印度佉卢文及大乘般若字母表之首五字，表一切法本不生、离尘垢、第一义谛、诸行无常、远离性相）；二为《圣妙吉祥真实名经（Mañjuśrīnāmasaṃgīti）》开篇六字明王「oṃ vākyedaṃ namaḥ」。
recitationTipsZh: 「a ra pa ca na」五字各为短元音 Laghu（1摩多），唯末尾种子字「dhīḥ」为送气浊齿音加长元音 ī 与止声 ḥ（2摩多 Guru），诵时尾音悠长清越。

verses.iast: oṃ a ra pa ca na dhīḥ ||
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切法本不生（A）、离诸尘染（Ra）、第一义谛清净（Pa）、诸法无自性行（Ca）、远离一切名相（Na），般若大智圆满（Dhīḥ）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Primordial non-arising (A), freedom from dust (Ra), ultimate truth (Pa), absence of inherent movement (Ca), transcendence of names (Na) — Supreme Wisdom (Dhīḥ)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵 阿 啰 跛 者 曩 地 ||
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 嗡 阿 啦 巴 佳 拿 迪希

words.meaningZh: 者字门：一切法无可迁行
曩字门：一切法远离名相

verses.iast: oṃ sarvadharmābhāvasvabhāvaviśuddhavajra a ā aṃ aḥ | prakṛtipariśuddhāḥ sarvadharmā yaduta sarvatathāgatajñānakāyamañjuśrīpariśuddhitām upādāyeti | a āḥ sarvatathāgata-hṛdaya hara hara | oṃ hūṃ hrīḥ bhagavan jñānamūrte vāgīśvara mahāpaca sarvadharmagaganāmalasupariśuddhadharmadhātujñānagarbha āḥ ||
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切诸法无性自性清净金刚！阿、阿、暗、恶！一切诸法自性清净，所谓由一切如来智身妙吉祥清净性故。阿、恶！一切如来心，摄持、摄持！嗡、吽、纥哩！世尊、智慧身尊、语自在王、大成熟者、一切法如虚空无垢极清净法界智藏啊！恶！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra of the pure nature of the non-existence of all dharmas: A Ā Aṃ Aḥ! All dharmas are naturally pure by virtue of the purity of Mañjuśrī, the Wisdom-Body of all Tathāgatas. O Bhagavan, Embodiment of Wisdom, Lord of Speech (Vāgīśvara), Womb of the Wisdom of the utterly pure Dharmadhātu spotless like the sky of all dharmas: Āḥ!

titleZh: 圣救度佛母十字心咒与百八名陀罗尼
titleEnglish: Noble Ārya Tārā Ten-Syllable Heart Mantra & 108 Names
translatorZh: （唐）不空 /（宋）法贤 译 · 尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典（DSBC / GRETIL tarb108u.htm）对勘
sutraSourceZh: 《佛说圣多罗菩萨一百八名陀罗尼经》(T20n1105) / GRETIL tarb108u.htm
deityZh: 圣绿度母 / 多罗菩萨 (Ārya-Tārā)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 多罗菩萨（Tārā，意译救度母、度脱母）从观自在菩萨大悲泪珠化现，能迅速救度狮、象、火、蛇、盗贼、牢狱、水溺、非人等八大怖畏（Aṣṭamahābhaya）。
recitationTipsZh: 「tāre（度母啊！阴性单数呼格）→ tuttāre（极度脱八难者啊！）→ ture（疾速救度者啊！）」三重递进，展现度母悲智力量的层层加被。

provenance.rawSnippet:
Āryatārābhaṭṭārikānāmāṣṭottaraśatakastotra oṃ namaḥ śrīmadāryatārāyai śrīmatpotalake ramye nānādhātuvirājite / nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpakṣinikūjite

nānānirjharajhaṃkāre nānāmṛgasamākule / nānākusumajātībhiḥ samantād adhivāsite

Tbh Tbh nānāhṛdayaphalopete ṣaṭpadodgītanisvane / kinnarair madhurair gītair mattavāraṇasaṃkule

Tbh Tbh Tbh siddhavidyādhāragaṇaiḥ gandharvaiś ca ninādite / munibhir vītarāgaiś ca satataṃ saṃniṣevite

Tbh Tbh Tbh Tbh bodhisatvagaṇaiś cānyaiḥ daśabhūmīśvarair api / āyatārādibhir devīvidyārājñīsahasrakaiḥ

Tbh Tbh Tbh Tbh Tbh krodharājagaṇaiś cānyaiḥ hayagrīvādibhir vṛte / sarvasatvahitodyukto bhagavān avalokitaḥ

vijahāra tataḥ śrīmān padmagarbhāsane sthitaḥ / mahatā tapasā yukto maitryā ca kṛpayānvitaḥ

dharmaṃ dideśa tasyāṃ sa mahatyāṃ devaparṣadi / tatropaviṣṭam āgamya vajrapāṇir mahābalaḥ

paramakṛpayā yuktaḥ papracchety avalokitam / taskaroragasiṃhāgnigajavyāghrāmbusaṃkaṭe

sīdanty amī mune satvā magnāḥ saṃsārasāgare / baddhāḥ saṃsārakaiḥ pāśai rāgadveṣatamopahaiḥ

mucyante yena saṃsārāt tan me brūhi mahāmune / evam ukte jagannāthaḥ sa śrīmān avalokitaḥ

uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ vajrapāṇiṃ prabodhinam / śṛṇu guhyakarājendra amitābhasya tāyinaḥ

praṇidhānavaśotpannā mamājñā lokamātaraḥ / mahākaruṇayopetā jagaduddharaṇoddhṛtāḥ

uditādityasaṃkāśāḥ pūrṇenduvadanaprabhāḥ / bhāsayanti drumāṃs tārāḥ sadevāsuramānuṣān

kampayanti trayo lokān trāsyantī yakṣarākṣasān / nīlotpalakarā devī mā bhair mā bhair iti bruvan

jagatsaṃrakṣaṇārthāya aham utpāditā jinaiḥ / kāntāre śastrasaṃparke nānābhayasamākule

smaraṇād eva nāmāni satvān rakṣāmy ahaṃ sadā / tārayiṣyāmy ahaṃ nātha nānābhayamahārṇavāt

tena tāreti maṃ loke gāyanti munipuṃgavāḥ / kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhūtvā tataḥ sādarasādhvasāḥ

jvalatīryantarīkṣestha idaṃ vacanam abravīt / nāmāṣṭaśatakaṃ brūhi yat purā kīrtitaṃ jinaiḥ

dāśabhūmīśvarair nāthair bodhisatvair maharddhikaiḥ / sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ māṅgalyaṃ kīrtivardhanam

dhanahānyakaraṃ caiva ārogyapuṣṭivardhanam / maitrīm ālambya satvānāṃ tat kīrtaya mahāmune

evam ukte 'tha bhagavān prahasann avalokitaḥ / vyavalokya diśaḥ sarvā maitryā sphuraṇayā dṛśā

dakṣiṇakaram uddhṛtya puṇyalakṣaṇamaṇḍitam / tam uvāca mahāprājñaḥ sādhu sādhu mahātapaḥ

nāmāni śṛṇu mahābhāga sarvasatvaikavatsalaḥ / yāni saṃkīrtya manujāḥ samyak te syur dhaneśvarāḥ

sarvavyādhivinirmuktāḥ sarvaiśvaryaguṇānvitāḥ / akālamṛtyunirdagdhāś cyutā yānti sukhāvatīm

tāny ahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi devasaṃghāḥ śṛṇudhva me anumodeta saddharme bhaviṣyadhvaṃ sunirvṛtāḥ

oṃ locane sulocane tāre tārotsave sarvasatvānukampini / sarvasatvottāriṇi sahasrabhuje sahasranetre

oṃ namo bhagavate 'valokya āvalokyā / sarvasatvānāṃ cāhaṃ phuṭ svāhā

oṃ śuddhe viśuddhe śodhanaviśodhani / sugatātmaje maitrīhṛdaye nirmale śyāme śyāmarūpiṇi

mahāprājñe pravare pravarabhūṣite parājite / mahāraudri viśvarūpi mahāyaśa

kalpāgnimahātejā lokadhātrīmahāyaśā / sarasvatī viśālākṣī prajñāśrībuddhivardhanī

oṃ dhṛtidā puṣṭidā svāhā oṃkārā kāmarūpiṇī / sarvasatvahitodyuktā saṃgrāme tāraṇī jayā

prajñāpāramitādevī āryātārā manoramā / dundubhisakhinī pūrṇavidyārājñī priyaṃvadā

candrānanā mahāgaurī ajitā pītavāsasā / mahāmāyā mahāśvetā mahābalaparākramā

mahāraudrī mahācaṇḍī duṣṭasatvanisūdanī / praśāntā śāntarūpā ca vijayā jvalanaprabhā

vidyunmālī dhvajī khaḍgī cakrī cāpayutāyudhā / jambhanī stambhanī kālī kālarātrī niśācarī

rakṣaṇī mohinī śāntā kāntā vibhāvinī śubhā / brāhmaṇī vedamātā ca guhā ca guhavāsinī

māṅgalyā śaṅkarī saumyā jātavedā manojavā / kāpālinī mahābhāgā saṃdhyā satyāparājitā

sārthavāhā kṛpadṛṣṭī naṣṭamārgapradarśanī / varadā śāsanī śāstrī strīrūpāmitavikramā

śavalī yoginī siddhā cāṇḍālī cāmṛtā dhruvā / dhanyā puṇyā mahābhāgā subhāgā priyadarśanī

kṛtāntatrāsanī bhīmā ugrā ugramahātapā / jagadekahitodyuktā śaraṇya bhaktivatsalā

vāgīśvarī śivā sūkṣmā nityā sarvārthamātṛkā / sarvārthasādhanī bhadrā goptrī dhātrī dhanaṃjayā

abhayā gautamī puṇyā śrīmallokeśvarātmajā / tārā nāmaguṇānantā sarvāśāparipūraṇī

nāmāṣṭottaraśatakaṃ tat kīrtitaṃ hitena vaḥ / rahasyam adbhutaṃ guhyaṃ devānām api durlabham / 43 saubhāgyaṃ bhāgyakaraṇaṃ sarvakīlbiṣanāśanam / sarvavyādhipraśamanaṃ sarvasatvasukhāvaham

trikāraṃ yaḥ paṭhed dhīmān śuciḥ snānasamāhitaḥ / acireṇaiva kālena rājyaśriyam avāpnuyāt

duḥkhitaḥ syāt sukhī nityadaridro dhanavān bhavet / jaḍo bhaven mahāprājño medhāvī ca na saṃśayaḥ

bandhanān mucyate baddho vyavahāre jayo bhavet / śatravo mitratāṃ yānti śṛṅgiṇaś cātha daṃṣṭriṇaḥ

saṃgrāme saṃkaṭe durge nānābhayasamākule / smaraṇād eva nāmāni sarvapāpāny apohati

nākālamṛtyur bhavati prāpnoti vipulāṃ śriyam / mānuśyaṃ saphalaṃ janma yasya kasya mahātmanaḥ

yaś cedaṃ prātar utthāya mānavaḥ kīrtayiṣyati / sa dīrghakālam āyuṣmān śriyaṃ ca labhate naraḥ

devā nāgās tathā yakṣā gandharvāḥ kaṭapūtanāḥ / piśācarākṣasā bhūtā mātaro raudratejasaḥ

kṣayāpasmārakārakaś caiva kṣatakākhorḍakādayaḥ / ḍākinyās tārakā pretāḥ skandā mārā mahāgrahāḥ

chāyām api na laṅghante kiṃ punas tasya vigrahaḥ / duṣṭasatvā na vādhante vyādhayo nākramanti ca

devāsuram api saṃgrāmam anubhavanti maharddhikāḥ / sarvaiśvaryaguṇair yuktaḥ putrapautraiś ca vardhate

jātismaro bhaved dhīmān kulīnaḥ priyadarśanaḥ

prītimāṃś ca mahāvāgmī sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ

kalyāṇamitrasaṃsevī bodhicittavibhūṣitaḥ / sadāvirahito buddhair yatra yatropapadyate

ity āryatārābhaṭṭārikāyā nāmāṣṭottaraśatakaṃ buddhabhāṣitaṃ samāptam

śubham

titleZh: 地藏菩萨灭定业真言与根本真言
titleEnglish: Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva Mantra for Eradicating Fixed Karma
translatorZh: （唐）不空 译《陀罗尼集》及汉传课诵传本
sutraSourceZh: 《地藏菩萨仪轨》(T20n1159B) / 显密圆通成佛心要集
deityZh: 大愿地藏王菩萨 (Mahāpraṇidhāna-Kṣitigarbha)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 汉传佛教最广为持诵之地藏法门心咒。「oṃ pramardani svāhā」意为摧伏、粉碎一切宿世定业结缚，令行者重报转轻、资粮具足。
recitationTipsZh: 汉传古音「唵 钵啰末邻陀宁 娑婆诃」对应的梵文还原为「oṃ pramardani svāhā」（或呼格 pramardane），词根 pra-√mṛd 意为彻底粉碎、摧灭（罪障）。

provenance.editionCitation: CBETA T20n1159B & Sanskrit reconstruction of Oṃ pramardani svāhā (cf. Digital Dictionary of Buddhism / 蔡文端梵文咒语校勘).
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 对勘唐密地藏菩萨真言「曩莫三曼多没驮喃 诃诃诃 素怛拿 娑嚩诃」与灭定业真言「唵 钵啰末邻陀宁 娑嚩诃」。

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！彻底摧碎一切定业烦恼障之圣力啊！圆满吉祥！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O Crusher and Destroyer (of fixed karmic obstacles)! Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵 钵啰末邻陀宁 娑嚩诃 ||
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 嗡 普啦玛尔达尼 斯瓦哈

words.meaningZh: 摧碎、研磨灭尽（定业罪障）者啊

verses.iast: namaḥ samantabuddhānāṃ | ha ha ha sutanu svāhā ||
verses.meaningZh: 归命普遍一切诸佛！哈哈（三解脱门法尔欢笑）！善妙庄严身（或希有胜妙尊）啊！圆满成就！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Universal Buddhas! Ha Ha Ha (Threefold Liberation)! O Wondrous Embodiment! Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 三曼多没驮喃 | 诃 诃 诃 素怛拿 娑嚩诃 ||
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 拿玛赫 萨曼达-布达南 | 哈 哈 哈 苏达努 斯瓦哈

titleZh: 圣无动尊大威怒王慈救咒与火界咒
titleEnglish: Ārya Acalanātha (Fudō Myōō) Compassionate Rescue & Fire-Realm Mantras
translatorZh: （唐）善无畏 译《大毗卢遮那成佛神变加持经》/（唐）不空 译《底哩三昧耶不动尊圣者念诵秘密法》
sutraSourceZh: 《大日经》卷二 (T18n0848) / 《不动使者陀罗尼秘密法》(T21n1200)
deityZh: 不动明王 / 圣无动尊 (Ārya-Acalanātha)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 五大明王之主尊，为大日如来教令轮身。右手持智慧利剑断除无明贪嗔，左手执金刚羂索系缚刚强难化众生令入菩提。本条收录最核心之「慈救咒（中咒）」与「一字心真言」。
recitationTipsZh: 「caṇḍamahāroṣaṇa」中「ṇḍ」与「ṣaṇa」均为卷舌音；「sphoṭaya（摧破、粉碎）」起首为复辅音 sph-，发音如清擦音 s 紧接送气清双唇塞音 ph。

provenance.editionCitation: CBETA T18n0848 《大毗卢遮那成佛神变加持经》卷二〈真言藏品〉& T21n1200 不空译轨.
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 依据唐密与东密传持之悉昙梵字写本《不动明王慈救咒》与《一字心真言》校订。

verses.iast: namaḥ samantavajrāṇāṃ | caṇḍamahāroṣaṇa sphoṭaya hūṃ traṭ hāṃ māṃ ||
verses.meaningZh: 归命普遍一切金刚众！暴恶大忿怒威德尊啊！请摧碎、击破一切魔障无明！吽！叱破（怛啰吒）！种子字憾、𤚥！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Universal Vajras! O Fierce and Greatly Wrathful One (Caṇḍamahāroṣaṇa), shatter and burst asunder (all obstacles)! Hūṃ Traṭ Hāṃ Māṃ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 三曼多嚩日啰赧 | 战拏摩诃嚧洒拏 娑破吒耶 吽 怛啰吒 憾 𤚥 ||
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 拿玛赫 萨曼达-瓦吉啦南 | 詹达玛哈洛沙拿 斯坡达呀 吽 特啦特 罕 芒

words.meaningZh: 威猛大忿怒尊（不动明王）啊
words.meaningEn: O Fierce and Greatly Wrathful One

words.meaningZh: 请粉碎、炸裂（一切业障魔军）

words.transliterationZh: 吽 怛啰吒 憾 𤚥
words.meaningZh: 恐怖摧破与不动明王根本种子字（hāṃ māṃ）
words.meaningEn: seed syllables of wrathful subjugation and Acalanātha

verses.meaningZh: 归命普遍一切金刚众！憾（不动明王一字心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Universal Vajras! Hāṃ!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫 三曼多嚩日啰赧 憾 ||

words.meaningZh: 不动尊菩提心不可动摇之根本种子字

titleZh: 普遍光明清净炽盛如意宝印心无能胜大明王大随求陀罗尼（根本心咒与随心真言精要）
titleEnglish: Heart & Upahṛdaya Mantras of Mahāpratisarā Vidyārājñī (Pañcarakṣā I)
translatorZh: （唐）不空 译 · 牛津 Hidas (2012) 校勘梵本（mahpratu.htm）及尼泊尔《五护陀罗尼》梵本对勘
sutraSourceZh: 《普遍光明清净炽盛如意宝印心无能胜大明王大随求陀罗尼经》(T20n1153) / GRETIL mahpratu.htm
deityZh: 大随求菩萨 (Mahāpratisarā)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 《五护陀罗尼（Pañcarakṣā）》第一部之日常修诵两道核心短咒（护身随心咒与摩尼金刚心咒）。全本 445 句长咒（含第一大品 282 句根本长咒、第二品护身咒、第三至四品无能胜心真言）已完整收录于「四大咒与根本长咒」之《大随求陀罗尼（全本445句）》及「DB1·房山石经卷八 pF28p0053a1701」「GRETIL mahpratu.htm」。
recitationTipsZh: 随求心咒「oṃ bhara bhara saṃbhara saṃbhara indriyabalaviśodhani hūṃ hūṃ ruru cale svāhā」兼具福智资粮聚集（saṃbhara）与诸根力清净（indriyabalaviśodhani）；如需受持四百余句根本长咒全本，请检索「大随求陀罗尼（全本445句）」。

provenance.editionCitation: Mahāpratisarā-Mahāvidyārājñī (Gergely Hidas 2012 Critical Edition, mahpratu.htm & Pañcarakṣā psarkdhu.htm)
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 日常持诵心咒与随心咒精要本；全本 445 句梵本见 mahapratisara-mahavidyarajni-complete 与房山石经 F28n1071 卷八。
provenance.rawSnippet: namaḥ sarvatathāgatānām | namo namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvasaṃghebhyaḥ | oṃ vipulagarbhe | vipulavimale | jayagarbhe | vajrajvālāgarbhe

verses.iast: oṃ bhara bhara saṃbhara saṃbhara indriyabalaviśodhani hūṃ hūṃ ruru cale svāhā ||

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Sustain, sustain! Accumulate, accumulate (merit and wisdom)! O Purifier of the faculties and spiritual powers! Hūṃ Hūṃ Ruru Cale Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵 跋啰 跋啰 三跋啰 三跋啰 因捺哩耶嚩攞尾戍驮你 吽 吽 噜噜 者隶 娑嚩诃 ||
verses.modernPhoneticZh: 嗡 巴啦 巴啦 桑巴啦 桑巴啦 因德哩呀巴啦维硕达尼 吽 吽 鲁鲁 佳咧 斯瓦哈

words.meaningZh: 集聚、圆满福智二种资粮

words.transliterationZh: 因捺哩耶嚩攞尾戍驮你
words.meaningZh: 清净信等五根、五力之圣母啊

verses.iast: oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā ||
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠母啊、执金刚母啊、大随求圣母啊！吽吽！摧破一切障碍（泮吒泮吒）！圆满成就！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O Jewel-Holder, O Vajra-Holder, O Great Pratisarā! Hūṃ Hūṃ Phaṭ Phaṭ Svāhā!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵 摩抳驮哩 嚩日哩抳 摩诃钵啰底萨隶 吽 吽 泮吒 泮吒 娑嚩诃 ||

titleZh: 佛母大孔雀明王心咒与根本陀罗尼（Pañcarakṣā）
titleEnglish: Great Peacock Queen Mahāmāyūrī Vidyārājñī Dhāraṇī (Pañcarakṣā II)
translatorZh: （唐）不空 译 · 东京大学高楠顺次郎校订梵本《Mahāmāyūrī》（GRETIL mmayuvru.htm）对勘
sutraSourceZh: 《佛母大孔雀明王经》(T19n0982) / GRETIL mmayuvru.htm
deityZh: 佛母大孔雀明王 (Mahāmāyūrī-Vidyārājñī)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 《五护陀罗尼》第二部。缘起于莎底比丘为毒蛇所螫，佛陀宣说此大孔雀明王真言，能除一切蛇毒、蛊毒、瘟疫、天旱水涝，护国息灾。
recitationTipsZh: 孔雀明王心咒「oṃ mayūrakrānte svāhā」意为「乘孔雀而行之圣母啊，吉祥成就！」其中 krānte 来自词根 √kram（跨步、乘御）。

provenance.editionCitation: Mahamayurividyarajni
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 直接关联自 GRETIL 下载之《Mahāmāyūrī Vidyārājñī》（mmayuvru.htm）梵文校勘本。
provenance.rawSnippet: Mahāmāyūrīvidyārājñī oṃ namo bhagavatyai āryamahāmāyūryai mṛtasaṃjīvanīṃ devīṃ duṣṭasatvanivāraṇīṃ vidyā rājñīṃ mahātmānīṃ māyūrīṃ praṇamāmy ahaṃ namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisatvebhyo 'rhadbhyaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhebhyo 'tītānāgatapratyutpannebhyaḥ sarvadharmamahāsaṃghebhyaḥ. namo buddhāya namo dharmāya namaḥ saṃghāya, namaḥ saptānāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānāṃ saśrāvakasaṃghānāṃ, namo loke 'rhatāṃ, namo maitreyapramukhānāṃ bodhisatvānāṃ mahāsatvānāṃ, namo 'nāgāmināṃ, namaḥ sakṛdāgāmināṃ, namaḥ śrotāpannānāṃ, namo loke samyaggatānāṃ, namaḥ samyakpratipannānāṃ. eṣāṃ namaskṛtvā imāṃ mahāmāyūrīṃ vidyārājñīṃ prayojayiṣyāmi. iyaṃ me vidyā samṛdhyatu, śṛṇvantu me bhūtagaṇāḥ. ye kecit pṛthivīcarāḥ khacarā jalacarā devā nāgā asurā marutā garuḍā gandharvāḥ kinnarā mahoragā yakṣā rākṣasāḥ pretāḥ piśācā bhūtāḥ kumbhāṇḍāḥ pūtanāḥ kaṭapūtanāḥ skandā unmādāś cchāyā apasmārā ostārakāḥ śṛṇvantu me ojāhārā bhūtagaṇā garbhāhārā rudhirāharā vasāhārā māṃsāhārā medāhārā majjāhārā jātāhārā jīvitāhārā balyāhārā mālyāhārā gandhāhārā dhūpāhārāḥ puṣpāhārāḥ phalāhārāḥ sasyāhārā āhutyāhārāḥ pūjāhārārā viṣṭyāhārā mūtrāhārāḥ kheṭāhārāḥ śleṣmāhārāḥ śiṃghāṇakāhārā ucchiṣṭāhārā vāntāhārā aśucyāhārāḥ syandanikāhārāḥ, pāpacittāḥ duṣṭacittā raudracittāḥ paraprāṇaharāḥ. imāṃ mahāmāyūrīvidyārājñīṃ pravakṣyāmi, gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ baliṃ ca dāsyāmi, apakrāmantu me pāpacittāḥ duṣṭacittā raudracittāḥ paraprāṇaharāḥ sarvagrahā ojohārāḥ śṛṇvantu me, saumyacittā maitracittāḥ kalyāṇacittāḥ śṛṇvantu me buddhadharmasaṃghābhiprasannāḥ. tadyathā kāli karāli kumbhāṇḍi śaṃkhini kamalākṣi harīti harikeśi śrīmati hari haripiṅgale, laṃbe pralaṃbe kālapāśe kālaśodari yamadūti yamarākṣasi bhūtagrasani, pratīcchatha māṃ, gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ baliṃ ca dāsyāmi, rakṣatha mama sagaṇaparivārāṇāṃ sarvasatvānāṃś ca sarvabhayopadravebhyaḥ, jīvatu varṣaśataṃ paśyatu śaradāśataṃ, sidhyantu me mantrapadāḥ svāhā. evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmiṃ samaye bhagavāṃ śrāvastyāṃ viharati sma, jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍasyārāme mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena mahatā bodhisatvasaṃghena sārdhaṃ, tena khalu punaḥ samayena śrāvastyāṃ jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍasyārāme svātir nāma bhikṣuḥ prativasati sma. navo dahrataruṇo 'cirapravrajito 'ciropasaṃpanno 'cirāgata imaṃ dharmavinayaṃ, saṃghasyārthe jentākadārūṇi pāṭayamānaḥ, anyatamasmāt pūtidāruśuṣirān niṣkramya mahatā kṛṣṇasarpeṇa dakṣiṇe pādāṃguṣṭho daṣṭaḥ sa klāntakāyo bhūmau nipatitaḥ, phenaṃ vāhayamāno 'kṣiṇī ca parivartayamānaḥ svapiti. adrākṣīd āyuṣmān ānandaḥ svātir nāma bhikṣum ābādhikaṃ duḥkhitaṃ gāḍhaglānaṃ bhūmau patitaṃ phenaṃ vāhayamānam akṣiṇī parivartayamānaṃ svapantaṃ, dṛṣṭvā ca punas tvaritaṃ tvaritaṃ yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ, upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvaikānte 'sthāt. ekāntasthitaś cāyuṣmān ānando bhagavantam etad avocat. iha bhagavan chrāvastyāṃ jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍasyārāme svātir nāma bhikṣuḥ prativasati, navo dahras taruṇo 'cirapravrajito 'ciropasaṃpanno 'cirāgata imaṃ dharmavinayaṃ. saṃghasyārthe jentākadārūṇi pāṭayamāno 'nyatamasmāt pūtidārusuṣirān niṣkramya mahatā kṛṣṇasarpeṇa dakṣiṇe pādāṃguṣṭho daṣṭaḥ. sa klāntakāyo bhūmau patitaḥ phenaṃ vāhayamāno 'kṣiṇī ca parivartayamānaḥ svapiti, tasyāhaṃ bhagavaṃ kathaṃ pratipadyāmi. evam ukte bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam etad avocat. gaccha tvam ānanda tathāgatasya vacanenānayā mahāmāyūryā vidyārājñyā svāter bhikṣo rakṣāṃ kuru, guptiṃ paritrāṇaṃ parigrahaṃ paripālanaṃ śāntiṃ svastyayanaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ śastraparihāraṃ viṣadūṣaṇaṃ viṣanāśanaṃ sīmābandhaṃ dharaṇībandhaṃ ca kuru. devagrahāto nāgagrahāto 'suragrahāto marutagrahāto garuḍagrahāto gandharvagrahātaḥ kinnaragrahāto mahoragagrahāto yakṣagrahāto rākṣasagrahātaḥ pretagrahātaḥ piśācagrahāto bhūtagrahātaḥ kumbhāṇḍagrahātaḥ pūtanagrahātaḥ kaṭapūtanagrahātaḥ skandagrahāto unmādagrahātaḥ chāyāgrahāto 'pasmāragrahāta ostārakagrahātaḥ kṛtyākarmaṇakākhordavetāḍakiraṇaciccakapreṣakadurbhuktaduścharditaduśchāyāduṣprekṣitadurlikhitadurlaṃghitāvadhūtātaḥ, jvarād ekāhikād dvaitīyakāt traitīyakāc cāturthakāt saptāhikād ardhamāsikān māsikād daivasikān mauhūrtikān nityajvarād viṣamajvarād bhūtajvarān mānuṣyajvarād amānuṣyajvarād vātikāt paittikāc chleṣmakāt sarvajvarāt, śirorttim apanaya ardhāvabhedakam arocakam akṣirogaṃ nāsārogaṃ mukharogaṃ kaṇṭharogaṃ hṛdrogaṃ galagrahaṃ karṇaśūlaṃ dantaśūlaṃ hṛdayaśūlaṃ pṛṣṭhaśūlaṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ udaraśūlaṃ maṇiśūlaṃ
